onslaught.name: Onslaught
onslaught.about: Twin and Power, melded. Twin's second blow, made heavy.
onslaught.frontText: Strikes twice, and the second blow lands at full strength instead of weaker, shoving what it hits a step back.
onslaught.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, at full strength.
onslaught.monsterText: Attacks twice; hits harder and has more life. Its second blow lands as hard as the first and knocks you back.

viper.name: Viper
viper.about: Twin and Poison, melded. Two fangs.
viper.frontText: A weaker hit that bites twice: two doses of poison at once, and its poison eats twice as fast (the same poison in half the time).
viper.behindText: Leaves two poison clouds; the second creeps toward the nearest enemy.
viper.monsterText: Attacks twice; poisons you. Each blow leaves two doses of poison on you.

flashfreeze.name: Flash Freeze
flashfreeze.about: Twin and Frost, melded. The first blow chills, the second freezes, all at once.
flashfreeze.frontText: Frost damage, striking twice: the first blow chills, the second freezes it on the spot (never a boss). A frozen enemy can't be flash-frozen again for a few seconds.
flashfreeze.behindText: Passes through and leaves ice twice: a second patch forms a moment after the first and freezes whatever stands in it.
flashfreeze.monsterText: Attacks twice; deals frost damage and slows you. If you are already chilled, its second blow freezes you for a moment.

rekindle.name: Rekindle
rekindle.about: Twin and Flame, melded. A fire that comes back.
rekindle.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; each burn lights again once when it goes out, as hot as before.
rekindle.behindText: Passes through and leaves burning ground that flares up once more after it dies down.
rekindle.monsterText: Attacks twice; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Its burn on you lights again once after it goes out.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.about: Twin and Swift, melded. Speed that turns into extra blows.
flurry.frontText: Faster to use again, and each use within a second of the last adds one more blow to it, up to four blows, each a little weaker.
flurry.behindText: Repeats itself sooner, and each repeat that lands gives you a burst of speed.
flurry.monsterText: Attacks twice; moves and attacks faster, and faster still while its blows keep landing on you.

aftershock.name: Aftershock
aftershock.about: Twin and Heavy, melded. The blow lands, then the ground answers.
aftershock.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; a moment later an aftershock bursts round where it hit, hurting and staggering everything near.
aftershock.behindText: Its cracked ground quakes twice, as it forms and again a second later, staggering whatever is on it both times.
aftershock.monsterText: Attacks twice; its blows knock you back. A moment after each blow, an aftershock bursts where you stood: step out of its ring.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.about: Leech and Power, melded. Healing you can't use becomes force.
bloodlust.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that heals you for every enemy it hits; while you are at full life, the healing becomes extra damage instead.
bloodlust.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs, and picking one up gives Power's damage bonus.
bloodlust.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; hits harder and has more life. At full life, its blows hit harder instead of healing it.

coldblood.name: Coldblood
coldblood.about: Leech and Frost, melded. Drinking the warmth out of what it freezes.
coldblood.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; it heals you twice as much from chilled or frozen enemies.
coldblood.behindText: Leaves ice that slows; enemies that die on the ice drop life orbs more often.
coldblood.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; deals frost damage and slows you. It heals twice as much while you are chilled.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.about: Leech and Lightning, melded. Life carried back along the bolt.
conduit.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; every enemy an arc strikes heals you too.
conduit.behindText: Leaves a storm; each enemy its bolts strike heals you a little.
conduit.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; deals lightning damage and shocks you. Its arcs heal the monsters they pass through.

secondwind.name: Second Wind
secondwind.about: Leech and Swift, melded. Each heal hurries you on.
secondwind.frontText: Faster to use again, and each time it heals you, its cooldown shortens a little more.
secondwind.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs, and picking one up gives you a burst of speed.
secondwind.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; moves and attacks faster. Each time it heals, it speeds up for a moment.

marrow.name: Marrow
marrow.about: Leech and Heavy, melded. Crush it, then drink.
marrow.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; hitting a stunned enemy heals you three times as much.
marrow.behindText: Its cracked ground drains a little life from whatever it staggers, for you.
marrow.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its blows knock you back. Knocking you back heals it a chunk.

quickfuse.name: Quickfuse
quickfuse.about: Volatile and Swift, melded. No wait between the kill and the blast.
quickfuse.frontText: Faster to use again; enemies it kills explode at once, and each explosion that kills shortens its cooldown a little.
quickfuse.behindText: Leaves a rune that goes off almost at once.
quickfuse.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; explodes when it dies. Its dying blast goes off at once, with no time to step away.

concussion.name: Concussion
concussion.about: Volatile and Heavy, melded. A blast that knocks the sense out of what it hits.
concussion.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; enemies it kills explode, and the blast stuns everything it catches.
concussion.behindText: Leaves a rune whose blast cracks the ground, staggering whatever walks over it after.
concussion.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; explodes when it dies. Its dying blast knocks you back and stuns you for a moment.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.about: Precise and Power, melded. Deadly one on one.
duelist.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; an enemy with no other enemy near it always takes a critical hit.
duelist.behindText: Marks an enemy; the marked one takes more damage from everything until the mark is spent.
duelist.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its hits find the gaps in your armour. When you are alone, every hit from it is critical.

needle.name: Needle
needle.about: Precise and Poison, melded. The venom goes in exactly where it hurts.
needle.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; a critical hit puts three doses on at once.
needle.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical and doubles the poison already on it.
needle.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; poisons you. Its critical hits poison you three times over.

brand.name: Brand
brand.about: Precise and Flame, melded. A mark burned in.
brand.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and burns; a critical hit brands the enemy, and a branded enemy burns twice as hot.
brand.behindText: Marks an enemy with a burning brand: it burns until the mark is spent, and your next hit on it is a certain critical.
brand.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Its critical hits brand you: your burn runs twice as hot.

seeker.name: Seeker
seeker.about: Precise and Lightning, melded. Lightning that picks its target.
seeker.frontText: Lightning damage whose arcs jump to the enemies with the least life, and arcs can be critical hits too.
seeker.behindText: Marks an enemy; lightning from any of your moves arcs to the marked one first.
seeker.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; deals lightning damage and shocks you. While you are shocked, its hits are critical.

quickdraw.name: Quickdraw
quickdraw.about: Precise and Swift, melded. The first shot is the one that counts.
quickdraw.frontText: Faster to use again; the first use after two seconds without using it is a certain critical.
quickdraw.behindText: Marks an enemy; landing the marked critical gives you a burst of speed and shortens its cooldown.
quickdraw.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its first blow after a pause is critical.

pressurepoint.name: Pressure Point
pressurepoint.about: Precise and Heavy, melded. Strike the stunned where it's weakest.
pressurepoint.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; every hit on a stunned enemy is a certain critical.
pressurepoint.behindText: Its cracked ground marks whatever it staggers: your next hit on it is a certain critical.
pressurepoint.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its next blow after knocking you back is critical.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.about: Frenzied and Power, melded. The faster you go, the harder you hit.
berserk.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each use makes the next faster and harder, up to five times.
berserk.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each kill adds to Power's damage bonus.
berserk.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; hits harder and has more life. It hits harder too as it is hurt.

fever.name: Fever
fever.about: Frenzied and Poison, melded. The poison quickens with your pulse.
fever.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; each use while frenzied adds one more dose, up to five.
fever.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and a poisoned enemy dying holds it twice as long.
fever.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; poisons you. Its poison works faster the more hurt it is.

whiteout.name: Whiteout
whiteout.about: Frenzied and Frost, melded. A storm of blows that buries them in cold.
whiteout.frontText: Frost damage; each use makes the next faster, and the faster you are, the harder it slows.
whiteout.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going and freeze the enemies near the one that died for a moment.
whiteout.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; deals frost damage and slows you. The more hurt it is, the more it slows you.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.about: Frenzied and Lightning, melded. The current builds with every swing.
overcharge.frontText: Lightning damage; each use makes the next faster and adds one more arc, up to five.
overcharge.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each kill throws a bolt at the nearest enemy.
overcharge.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; deals lightning damage and shocks you. As it is hurt, its lightning arcs farther.

blur.name: Blur
blur.about: Frenzied and Swift, melded. Too fast to see.
blur.frontText: Faster to use again; at a full frenzy of five you also move faster and dodge more.
blur.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going and give you a burst of speed.
blur.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; moves and attacks faster. Badly hurt, it becomes a blur for a few seconds, very fast.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.about: Frenzied and Heavy, melded. Slow to start, impossible to stop.
juggernaut.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; each use makes the next faster, and at a full frenzy it is no slower at all.
juggernaut.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; at a full frenzy its cracked ground spreads twice as wide.
juggernaut.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows knock you back. The more hurt it is, the farther it knocks you.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.about: Guarding and Power, melded. Strong behind a strong shield.
bulwark.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each use gives you a brief shield, and while it holds your hits land harder.
bulwark.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it Power's damage bonus builds twice as fast.
bulwark.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; hits harder and has more life. While its shield holds, it hits harder.

hemlock.name: Hemlock
hemlock.about: Guarding and Poison, melded. A shield that bites back.
hemlock.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; each use gives you a brief shield, and whatever strikes the shield is poisoned.
hemlock.behindText: Leaves a ward circle that poisons enemies standing in it.
hemlock.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; poisons you. Hitting its shield poisons you.

cinderward.name: Cinderward
cinderward.about: Guarding and Flame, melded. When the shield breaks, it burns.
cinderward.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and burns; each use gives you a brief shield that bursts in flame round you when it breaks or fades.
cinderward.behindText: Leaves a ward circle ringed in fire: enemies crossing its edge are set burning.
cinderward.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; deals fire damage and sets you burning. When its shield breaks, it bursts in flame.

static.name: Static
static.about: Guarding and Lightning, melded. Touch the shield and get shocked.
static.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs; each use gives you a brief shield, and whatever strikes the shield is struck by an arc.
static.behindText: Leaves a ward circle whose edge throws arcs at enemies inside it.
static.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; deals lightning damage and shocks you. Hitting its shield shocks you.

windward.name: Windward
windward.about: Guarding and Swift, melded. Sheltered and quick.
windward.frontText: Faster to use again; each use gives you a brief shield, and while it holds you move faster.
windward.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you move faster and take less damage.
windward.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; moves and attacks faster. While its shield holds, it is faster still.

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.about: Guarding and Heavy, melded. Nothing moves you.
fortress.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; each use gives you a shield, and while it holds nothing knocks you back or stuns you.
fortress.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; enemies stepping into it are staggered.
fortress.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its blows knock you back. While its shield holds, nothing staggers or stops it.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.about: Lasting and Power, melded. Force that keeps building while you keep hitting.
momentum.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each hit that lands makes the next a little harder, and the build-up holds until you go three seconds without landing one.
momentum.behindText: Power's damage bonus lasts half again as long and builds two steps higher.
momentum.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; each blow it lands makes its next harder, until it stops landing them.

canker.name: Canker
canker.about: Lasting and Poison, melded. A poison that won't wear off.
canker.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; its poison lasts twice as long and doesn't wear off while you keep hitting.
canker.behindText: Leaves a poison cloud that lasts twice as long.
canker.monsterText: Its poison lasts longer on you; poisons you. Its poison doesn't wear off while it keeps hitting you.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.about: Lasting and Frost, melded. Cold that never lets go.
permafrost.frontText: Frost damage; its chill lasts twice as long, and what it freezes stays frozen half again as long.
permafrost.behindText: Leaves ice that slows and lasts until the fight is over.
permafrost.monsterText: Its chill lasts longer on you; deals frost damage and slows you. Its slow keeps deepening while you stay within its reach.

smoulder.name: Smoulder
smoulder.about: Lasting and Flame, melded. The fire outlives its fuel.
smoulder.frontText: Fire damage that explodes; burns last twice as long, and an enemy that dies burning leaves smouldering ground where it fell.
smoulder.behindText: Leaves burning ground that lasts much longer.
smoulder.monsterText: Its burning lasts longer on you; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Where it dies, the ground smoulders.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.about: Lasting and Lightning, melded. The storm stays.
tempest.frontText: Lightning damage; enemies it shocks stay shocked longer, and for three seconds arcs keep leaping between them.
tempest.behindText: Leaves a storm that lasts twice as long.
tempest.monsterText: Its shock lasts longer on you; deals lightning damage and shocks you. While you are shocked, small arcs keep striking you.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.about: Lasting and Swift, melded. Speed that stays with you.
tailwind.frontText: Faster to use again; each use also gives a burst of speed that lasts while you keep using it.
tailwind.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed that lasts half again as long.
tailwind.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; stays fast long after each blow.

bedrock.name: Bedrock
bedrock.about: Lasting and Heavy, melded. The ground stays broken.
bedrock.frontText: Slower, hits much harder, and its stun lasts half again as long.
bedrock.behindText: Leaves cracked ground that lasts until the fight is over.
bedrock.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; you stay staggered longer after each.

haymaker.name: Haymaker
haymaker.about: Fleeting and Power, melded. A hard blow with no warning.
haymaker.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit, and it lands sooner: less wind-up before the blow.
haymaker.behindText: Power's damage bonus builds twice as fast and fades in half the time.
haymaker.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows come with less warning.

bloat.name: Bloat
bloat.about: Fleeting and Poison, melded. The poison works fast, then bursts out.
bloat.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; its poison works in a third less time, and when it runs out the enemy bursts in a small cloud of it.
bloat.behindText: Leaves a poison cloud that fades fast and bursts on whatever is inside as it goes.
bloat.monsterText: Its poison hurts you faster; poisons you. When its poison on you runs out, it bursts round you.

coldsnap.name: Cold Snap
coldsnap.about: Fleeting and Frost, melded. A sudden, biting cold.
coldsnap.frontText: Frost damage; its chill is shorter but deeper, and hitting a chilled enemy snaps the chill off for extra damage.
coldsnap.behindText: Leaves ice that melts fast, freezing what stands on it as it goes.
coldsnap.monsterText: Its chill on you is short but deep; deals frost damage and slows you.

flashfire.name: Flashfire
flashfire.about: Fleeting and Flame, melded. Burns that go up all at once.
flashfire.frontText: Fire damage; its burns do all their harm in half the time, and a burn ending sends up a flare that hits those near.
flashfire.behindText: Leaves burning ground that burns hotter and dies faster.
flashfire.monsterText: Its burning hurts you faster; deals fire damage and sets you burning. When its burn on you ends, it flares.

jolt.name: Jolt
jolt.about: Fleeting and Lightning, melded. All the shock in one instant.
jolt.frontText: Lightning damage; a shocked enemy takes all of the shock's harm in a single jolt the next time you hit it.
jolt.behindText: Leaves a storm that lets loose all its bolts in one moment.
jolt.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its shock hits you all at once.

blink.name: Blink
blink.about: Fleeting and Swift, melded. Gone before they see you move.
blink.frontText: Faster to use again, and for a moment after each use you move very fast.
blink.behindText: Each use gives a burst of speed a third as long and much faster.
blink.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; darts at you in short, very fast bursts.

daze.name: Daze
daze.about: Fleeting and Heavy, melded. A short stun that leaves them wide open.
daze.frontText: Slower, hits much harder; its stun is shorter, but every hit on a stunned enemy lands harder.
daze.behindText: Its cracked ground staggers in quick, short jolts, more often.
daze.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; while you are staggered, it hits you harder.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.about: Vast and Power, melded. The bigger the crowd, the bigger the blow.
cataclysm.frontText: A much bigger area; the hit lands harder for every enemy it catches.
cataclysm.behindText: Each hit splashes harder onto the enemies near what it hits.
cataclysm.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its attacks reach much wider.

miasma.name: Miasma
miasma.about: Vast and Poison, melded. A haze that thickens as it spreads.
miasma.frontText: A weaker hit over a much bigger area that poisons everything it touches; the more enemies it poisons at once, the stronger each dose.
miasma.behindText: Leaves a poison cloud that slowly grows.
miasma.monsterText: Poisons you; its attacks reach wider and leave a haze of poison where they land.

glacier.name: Glacier
glacier.about: Vast and Frost, melded. The cold spreads from one to the next.
glacier.frontText: Frost damage over a much bigger area; when it freezes an enemy, the ice spreads to those touching it and chills them.
glacier.behindText: Leaves a wide field of ice that slowly creeps outward.
glacier.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its attacks reach wider and frost the ground where they land.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.about: Vast and Flame, melded. Fire that runs across the floor.
inferno.frontText: Fire damage over a much bigger area; burning enemies set the ground alight where they walk.
inferno.behindText: Leaves burning ground that spreads outward for a few seconds.
inferno.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its attacks reach wider and set the ground alight.

stormfront.name: Stormfront
stormfront.about: Vast and Lightning, melded. One hit links the whole crowd.
stormfront.frontText: Lightning damage over a much bigger area; every enemy it hits is linked, and lightning flicks between linked enemies for a few seconds.
stormfront.behindText: Leaves a storm that drifts wide, striking anything in a much bigger area.
stormfront.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its attacks and its lightning reach wider.

gale.name: Gale
gale.about: Vast and Swift, melded. A sweep that clears the room.
gale.frontText: Faster to use again, a much bigger area, and it blows the enemies it hits back to its edge.
gale.behindText: Each use gives a burst of speed to you and every ally near you.
gale.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its attacks reach wider and push you away.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.about: Vast and Heavy, melded. The stun rolls out like a wave.
earthquake.frontText: Slower, hits much harder, and its stun rolls out in a wide wave from where it lands, reaching the far side a moment late.
earthquake.behindText: Leaves a wide field of cracked ground.
earthquake.monsterText: Its blows knock you back from much farther away.

onrush.name: Onrush
onrush.about: Swift and Power, melded. Speed turned into force.
onrush.frontText: Faster to use again; more damage and a bigger hit, and half again as hard while a burst of speed is on you.
onrush.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, Power's damage bonus doesn't fade.
onrush.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; hits harder and has more life. Its first blow after running at you hits half again as hard.

hornet.name: Hornet
hornet.about: Swift and Poison, melded. Quick stings that pile the venom on.
hornet.frontText: Faster to use again; a weaker hit that poisons, and each use within a second of the last puts one more dose on, up to three.
hornet.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, every hit you land poisons too.
hornet.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; poisons you. Each blow within a second of its last leaves an extra dose.

glide.name: Glide
glide.about: Swift and Frost, melded. The ice carries you.
glide.frontText: Faster to use again; frost damage that chills, and each chilled enemy it hits gives you a little speed.
glide.behindText: Leaves ice that slows enemies but speeds you up while you stand on it.
glide.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; deals frost damage and slows you. On ice it is faster still.

firewalk.name: Firewalk
firewalk.about: Swift and Flame, melded. Fire at your heels.
firewalk.frontText: Faster to use again; fire damage that explodes and burns, and its explosions are bigger while a burst of speed is on you.
firewalk.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, you leave burning footprints.
firewalk.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; deals fire damage and sets you burning. It leaves burning footprints where it runs.

quicksilver.name: Quicksilver
quicksilver.about: Swift and Lightning, melded. Lightning that carries you with it.
quicksilver.frontText: Faster to use again; lightning damage that arcs, and every arc that strikes gives you a little speed.
quicksilver.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, enemies you run past are struck by an arc.
quicksilver.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; deals lightning damage and shocks you. While you are shocked, it is faster still.

charge.name: Charge
charge.about: Swift and Heavy, melded. The weight of a blow without the wait.
charge.frontText: Hits much harder and stuns, but is no slower to use; every enemy it stuns makes it a little faster to use again.
charge.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, running into enemies staggers them.
charge.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its blows knock you back. It charges in, and its first blow knocks you back twice as far.

mire.name: Mire
mire.about: Heavy and Poison, melded. The broken ground turns to poison mud.
mire.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, and poisons; poison on a stunned enemy eats twice as fast.
mire.behindText: Leaves cracked ground that staggers, and whatever it staggers is poisoned too.
mire.monsterText: Its blows knock you back and poison you. While you are staggered, its poison eats faster.

icebreaker.name: Icebreaker
icebreaker.about: Heavy and Frost, melded. Freeze it, then break it.
icebreaker.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, with frost damage that chills; a blow on a frozen enemy breaks the ice for heavy extra damage, and the shards stagger everything around it.
icebreaker.behindText: Leaves cracked ground glazed with ice: whatever it staggers is chilled too.
icebreaker.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; deals frost damage and slows you. Knocked back while chilled, you freeze for a moment.

anvil.name: Anvil
anvil.about: Heavy and Flame, melded. Every blow throws sparks.
anvil.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, with fire damage that explodes; a stunned enemy burns twice as hot.
anvil.behindText: Leaves cracked ground glowing like a forge: whatever walks over it is set burning.
anvil.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; deals fire damage and sets you burning. Where it knocks you, the ground is left burning.

fulgurite.name: Fulgurite
fulgurite.about: Heavy and Lightning, melded. Lightning driven into the ground.
fulgurite.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, with lightning that arcs; its arcs stun too, for a moment.
fulgurite.behindText: Leaves cracked ground that carries lightning: bolts run along the cracks to whatever stands on them.
fulgurite.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; deals lightning damage and shocks you. Where its blows land, the ground crackles for a few seconds.

lamprey.name: Lamprey
lamprey.about: Twin and Leech, melded. The second bite drinks deeper.
lamprey.frontText: Strikes twice; both blows heal you, and the second heals twice as much as the first.
lamprey.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, and the repeat heals you for every enemy it hits.
lamprey.monsterText: Attacks twice; heals when it hits you. Its second blow heals it twice as much.

cluster.name: Cluster
cluster.about: Twin and Volatile, melded. One blast scatters into more.
cluster.frontText: Strikes twice; enemies it kills explode, and each explosion throws out two small bomblets that burst where they land.
cluster.behindText: Leaves two runes; the second goes off a moment after the first.
cluster.monsterText: Attacks twice; explodes when it dies, scattering bomblets around it.

doubletap.name: Doubletap
doubletap.about: Twin and Precise, melded. If the first one lands true, so does the second.
doubletap.frontText: Strikes twice, a smaller area; when the first blow is a critical hit, the second is a certain critical too.
doubletap.behindText: Marks two enemies at once: your next hit on each is a certain critical.
doubletap.monsterText: Attacks twice; its hits find the gaps in your armour. When its first blow is critical, so is its second.

tempo.name: Tempo
tempo.about: Twin and Frenzied, melded. Every beat counts double.
tempo.frontText: Strikes twice, and both blows add to the frenzy, so it builds twice as fast.
tempo.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, and the repeat's kills keep the frenzy going too.
tempo.monsterText: Attacks twice; speeds up as it is hurt. Every blow it lands speeds it up a little more.

redoubt.name: Redoubt
redoubt.about: Twin and Guarding, melded. Behind the wall, another wall.
redoubt.frontText: Strikes twice; each use gives you a brief shield, and when it breaks a second, smaller one forms.
redoubt.behindText: Leaves two ward circles, one inside the other; deep inside you take even less damage.
redoubt.monsterText: Attacks twice; carries a shield that soaks damage. When its shield breaks, a smaller one forms.

reverb.name: Reverb
reverb.about: Twin and Lasting, melded. Each blow rings on.
reverb.frontText: Strikes twice, and every poison, burn, chill or shock it leaves lasts half again as long for each blow that lands.
reverb.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, and what the repeat leaves lasts twice as long.
reverb.monsterText: Attacks twice; its poison, burning and chill last longer on you with every blow that lands.

staccato.name: Staccato
staccato.about: Twin and Fleeting, melded. Two blows in the time of one.
staccato.frontText: Strikes twice with no pause between, and what it leaves works in a third less time.
staccato.behindText: Repeats itself almost at once instead of a moment later.
staccato.monsterText: Attacks twice, the second blow coming with no warning.

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.about: Twin and Vast, melded. The second blow spreads out from the first.
ripple.frontText: Strikes twice; the second blow lands as a wider ring around the first, catching what the first missed.
ripple.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, over a much bigger area.
ripple.monsterText: Attacks twice; its second attack reaches much wider.

bloodbloom.name: Bloodbloom
bloodbloom.about: Leech and Volatile, melded. Every blast feeds you.
bloodbloom.frontText: Enemies it kills explode, and each blast heals you for every enemy it catches.
bloodbloom.behindText: Leaves a rune; enemies its blast kills drop life orbs.
bloodbloom.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; explodes when it dies, and its blast heals the monsters near it.

lancet.name: Lancet
lancet.about: Leech and Precise, melded. A surgeon's cut that feeds you.
lancet.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; heals you for every enemy hit, and a critical hit heals three times as much.
lancet.behindText: Marks an enemy: your certain critical on it also heals you for a share of the hit.
lancet.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its critical hits heal it three times as much.

feedingfrenzy.name: Feeding Frenzy
feedingfrenzy.about: Leech and Frenzied, melded. The faster you go, the more you drink.
feedingfrenzy.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times, and the higher the frenzy, the more each hit heals you.
feedingfrenzy.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and at a full frenzy enemies it kills drop life orbs.
feedingfrenzy.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; heals when it hits you, more the faster it goes.

carapace.name: Carapace
carapace.about: Leech and Guarding, melded. Healing you can't use hardens into a shell.
carapace.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit; healing beyond full life becomes a shield.
carapace.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you slowly heal.
carapace.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; carries a shield that soaks damage, and its healing tops the shield up.

transfusion.name: Transfusion
transfusion.about: Leech and Lasting, melded. The life keeps flowing.
transfusion.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, and the healing keeps coming in over the next few seconds, half again as much in all.
transfusion.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs that last much longer and heal over a few seconds.
transfusion.monsterText: Heals when it hits you, and keeps healing for a few seconds after.

lifeline.name: Lifeline
lifeline.about: Leech and Fleeting, melded. The heal comes fastest when you need it most.
lifeline.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit; below half life, it heals twice as much.
lifeline.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs that fly straight to you.
lifeline.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; below half life, it heals twice as much.

bloodtide.name: Bloodtide
bloodtide.about: Leech and Vast, melded. The healing washes over everyone.
bloodtide.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; heals you for every enemy hit, and allies near you are healed too.
bloodtide.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits, and the splash heals you as well.
bloodtide.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its attacks reach wider, and its healing reaches the monsters near it.

detonator.name: Detonator
detonator.about: Volatile and Precise, melded. A charge set exactly where it hurts.
detonator.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; a critical hit plants a charge that bursts a moment later, hurting everything near.
detonator.behindText: Marks an enemy; when the marked one dies, it explodes twice as big.
detonator.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; explodes when it dies. Its critical hits plant a charge on you that bursts a moment later.

mayhem.name: Mayhem
mayhem.about: Volatile and Frenzied, melded. Every blast winds you up.
mayhem.frontText: Each use makes the next faster; enemies it kills explode, and each explosion adds to the frenzy.
mayhem.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and at a full frenzy enemies it kills explode.
mayhem.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; explodes when it dies, and the faster it was going, the bigger the blast.

minefield.name: Minefield
minefield.about: Volatile and Guarding, melded. Holding ground that bites back.
minefield.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; enemies it kills while your shield holds explode.
minefield.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; enemies that die inside it explode.
minefield.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; explodes when it dies, twice as big if its shield was still up.

timebomb.name: Timebomb
timebomb.about: Volatile and Lasting, melded. The longer the wait, the bigger the bang.
timebomb.frontText: Enemies it kills explode a second later, twice as big.
timebomb.behindText: Leaves a rune that waits twice as long before it goes off, and goes off twice as big.
timebomb.monsterText: Explodes when it dies, a second later and twice as hard: get clear.

hairtrigger.name: Hair Trigger
hairtrigger.about: Volatile and Fleeting, melded. The slightest touch sets it off.
hairtrigger.frontText: An enemy brought below a tenth of its life explodes at once (never a boss).
hairtrigger.behindText: Leaves a rune that goes off the instant an enemy touches it.
hairtrigger.monsterText: Explodes when it dies; brought very low, it bursts at once.

blastwave.name: Blastwave
blastwave.about: Volatile and Vast, melded. Blasts that clear the room.
blastwave.frontText: A much bigger area; enemies it kills explode, and each blast throws the enemies it doesn't kill out to its edge.
blastwave.behindText: Leaves a rune whose blast covers a much bigger area.
blastwave.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; explodes when it dies, and the blast throws you back.

rapier.name: Rapier
rapier.about: Precise and Frenzied, melded. Quicker, and quicker to find the gap.
rapier.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; each use makes the next faster, and the higher the frenzy, the more often it lands a critical hit.
rapier.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and a critical kill adds two steps to it.
rapier.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its hits find the gaps in your armour, and the more hurt it is, the more often it lands critical hits.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.about: Precise and Guarding, melded. Block, then strike back true.
riposte.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; whatever strikes the shield, your next hit on it is a certain critical.
riposte.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; your hits on enemies inside it are critical more often.
riposte.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its hits find the gaps in your armour. When you strike its shield, its next blow on you is critical.

vendetta.name: Vendetta
vendetta.about: Precise and Lasting, melded. It won't forget who it marked.
vendetta.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; a critical hit marks the enemy, and every hit on it after is more likely to be critical until it dies.
vendetta.behindText: Marks an enemy until it dies: every third hit on it is a certain critical.
vendetta.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour. Once it lands a critical hit on you, more of its hits are critical for a while.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.about: Precise and Fleeting, melded. The first strike is the deadly one.
ambush.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; the first hit on an enemy that hasn't been hurt yet is a certain critical.
ambush.behindText: Marks an enemy for only a moment; hit it in time and the certain critical does double damage.
ambush.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its first blow on you is always critical.

bullseye.name: Bullseye
bullseye.about: Precise and Vast, melded. A wide blow with a deadly heart.
bullseye.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; the enemy nearest its middle takes a certain critical.
bullseye.behindText: Marks every enemy near what it hits, not just one: your next hit on each is a certain critical.
bullseye.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider. If you stand at the heart of its attack, its hit is critical.

shieldwall.name: Shieldwall
shieldwall.about: Frenzied and Guarding, melded. The harder you fight, the thicker the wall.
shieldwall.frontText: Each use makes the next faster and gives you a brief shield that grows with the frenzy, up to twice as big at five.
shieldwall.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; kills inside it keep the frenzy going twice as long.
shieldwall.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; carries a shield that soaks damage, and its shield grows as it speeds up.

fury.name: Fury
fury.about: Frenzied and Lasting, melded. Once it's lit, it doesn't go out.
fury.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times, and the frenzy fades one step at a time instead of all at once.
fury.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going twice as long.
fury.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt, and once fast, it stays fast.

spree.name: Spree
spree.about: Frenzied and Fleeting, melded. All at once, then gone.
spree.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, each step twice as big, but the frenzy fades in half the time.
spree.behindText: Each kill adds two steps to the frenzy, but it fades in half the time.
spree.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt, in sudden bursts.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.about: Frenzied and Vast, melded. The wilder it gets, the more it catches.
rampage.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, and its area grows with the frenzy, up to much bigger at five.
rampage.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each hit's splash grows with the frenzy.
rampage.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its attacks reach wider as it gets faster.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.about: Guarding and Lasting, melded. A safe place that holds.
sanctuary.frontText: Each use gives you a shield that lasts twice as long.
sanctuary.behindText: Leaves a ward circle that lasts until the fight is over.
sanctuary.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; broken, it grows back after a few seconds.

parry.name: Parry
parry.about: Guarding and Fleeting, melded. A guard held for only an instant, but nothing gets through.
parry.frontText: Each use gives you a shield for only a moment, but while it is up you take no damage at all.
parry.behindText: Leaves a ward circle that fades fast, but inside it you take no damage.
parry.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; for a moment after each of its attacks, it takes much less damage.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.about: Guarding and Vast, melded. One shield over everyone.
aegis.frontText: Each use gives a brief shield to you and to every ally near you.
aegis.behindText: Leaves a much bigger ward circle.
aegis.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage, and its shield covers the monsters near it too.

hourglass.name: Hourglass
hourglass.about: Lasting and Fleeting, melded. Time on your side, and against them.
hourglass.frontText: Everything it puts on enemies lasts half again as long, and every poison, burn or chill on you wears off a third sooner.
hourglass.behindText: What it leaves on the ground lasts half again as long and works a third faster.
hourglass.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you and hurt you faster too.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.about: Lasting and Vast, melded. The ground keeps hurting after the blow.
aftermath.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; for a few seconds after, enemies that walk into where it struck are hit again, weaker.
aftermath.behindText: Each hit's splash lingers on the ground for a moment, hitting enemies that step into it.
aftermath.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider, and the ground where they land keeps hurting you for a few seconds.

whipcrack.name: Whipcrack
whipcrack.about: Fleeting and Vast, melded. Wide, and with no warning.
whipcrack.frontText: A much bigger area, and the whole of it lands at once with no wind-up.
whipcrack.behindText: Each hit's splash goes off at once and reaches farther.
whipcrack.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider and come with less warning.

maw.name: Maw
maw.about: Pulling and Power, melded. Drag them in, then crush them together.
maw.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck; those that meet there crash together and hurt each other.
maw.behindText: Leaves a vortex that keeps drawing enemies in; when it ends it collapses in a blast, harder for each enemy inside.
maw.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows drag you toward it, and its next blow after a drag hits harder.

sump.name: Sump
sump.about: Pulling and Poison, melded. Everything drains to one place.
sump.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons and drags what it hits toward where it struck; each enemy pulled in takes one more dose for each poisoned enemy beside it, up to three.
sump.behindText: Leaves a vortex of poison that draws enemies in and poisons them while it holds them.
sump.monsterText: Poisons you; its blows drag you toward it, and each drag leaves one more dose on you.

drift.name: Drift
drift.about: Pulling and Frost, melded. They slide in on the ice.
drift.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; drags what it hits toward where it struck, chilled enemies twice as far, and those that slide into each other freeze (never a boss).
drift.behindText: Leaves an icy vortex; enemies drawn across it are slowed, and those that reach its middle freeze for a moment (never a boss).
drift.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows drag you toward it, twice as far while you are chilled.

firewhirl.name: Firewhirl
firewhirl.about: Pulling and Flame, melded. A whirl of fire that feeds on what it gathers.
firewhirl.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; the blast drags enemies at its edge into its middle, and those it pulls in burn hotter.
firewhirl.behindText: Leaves a vortex of fire that draws enemies in and sets burning whatever it holds.
firewhirl.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows drag you toward it, and each drag sets you burning again.

lodestone.name: Lodestone
lodestone.about: Pulling and Lightning, melded. The bolt drags what it touches along.
lodestone.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; every enemy an arc strikes is dragged toward the one it leapt from.
lodestone.behindText: Leaves a storm that draws enemies in; its bolts strike first the ones it has pulled closest.
lodestone.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows drag you toward it, farther while you are shocked.

riptide.name: Riptide
riptide.about: Pulling and Swift, melded. A current too quick to stand against.
riptide.frontText: Faster to use again; drags what it hits toward where it struck, and each use within a second of the last pulls from farther, up to three times.
riptide.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, enemies near you are drawn along in your wake.
riptide.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its blows drag you toward it, and it rushes in after each drag.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.about: Pulling and Heavy, melded. The ground itself pulls everything in.
gravity.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; drags in everything near where it struck, not only what it hits, and stuns those it pulls in for longer.
gravity.behindText: Leaves a vortex over cracked ground; what it draws in is staggered again and again.
gravity.monsterText: Its blows pull you in instead of knocking you back, and its next blow lands harder.

splinter.name: Splinter
splinter.about: Splitting and Power, melded. It breaks, and every piece still hits like the whole.
splinter.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; breaks into three copies that fly on, each half as strong again as Splitting's, and each knocks back what it hits.
splinter.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out in every direction; each shard that lands builds Power's damage bonus.
splinter.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; splits in two when it dies, and its halves keep its strength.

spore.name: Spore
spore.about: Splitting and Poison, melded. A sickness that scatters.
spore.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; breaks into three copies that fly on and poison what they hit.
spore.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out and each leaves a small cloud of poison where it lands.
spore.monsterText: Poisons you; splits in two when it dies, and each half leaves a puff of poison.

sleet.name: Sleet
sleet.about: Splitting and Frost, melded. Cold that comes down in pieces.
sleet.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; breaks into three icy copies that fly on, and a copy that hits a frozen enemy splits again, once.
sleet.behindText: Where it ends, shards of ice fly out and each leaves a patch of ice that slows.
sleet.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; splits in two when it dies, and its halves leave ice where they walk.

embers.name: Embers
embers.about: Splitting and Flame, melded. The fire breaks into sparks that start fires of their own.
embers.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; breaks into three copies that fly on, each exploding where it lands.
embers.behindText: Where it ends, burning shards fly out and each leaves a small patch of burning ground.
embers.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; splits in two when it dies, both halves burning.

fractal.name: Fractal
fractal.about: Splitting and Lightning, melded. Every branch grows branches.
fractal.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; breaks into three copies that fly on, and each copy arcs on its own.
fractal.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out, and each one that strikes calls a small bolt down where it lands.
fractal.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; splits in two when it dies, and a crackling arc joins its halves that hurts you to cross.

scatter.name: Scatter
scatter.about: Splitting and Swift, melded. The faster you go, the more pieces.
scatter.frontText: Faster to use again; breaks into three copies, and each use within a second of the last makes one more copy, up to five.
scatter.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, every hit you land throws off a shard.
scatter.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; splits in two when it dies, and its halves are faster still.

rubble.name: Rubble
rubble.about: Splitting and Heavy, melded. It breaks like a boulder breaks.
rubble.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; breaks into three heavy copies that fly on and stagger what they hit.
rubble.behindText: Where it ends, chunks fly out and crack the ground where each lands, staggering enemies that cross.
rubble.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; splits in two when it dies, and each half lands with a knock.

doom.name: Doom
doom.about: Hexing and Power, melded. A curse that deepens with every blow.
doom.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that curses; each hit on a cursed enemy deepens its curse, up to three times.
doom.behindText: Leaves a hex circle where enemies deal less damage; each hit you land on an enemy inside builds Power's damage bonus twice as fast.
doom.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows curse you, and it hits a cursed you harder still.

plague.name: Plague
plague.about: Hexing and Poison, melded. The curse and the sickness pass on together.
plague.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons and curses; a cursed enemy that dies passes its curse and its poison to the nearest enemy.
plague.behindText: Leaves a hex circle that poisons; enemies inside deal less damage and are poisoned while they stand in it.
plague.monsterText: Poisons you and curses you; while you are cursed its poison hurts you faster.

hoarfrost.name: Hoarfrost
hoarfrost.about: Hexing and Frost, melded. A cold that settles into the bones.
hoarfrost.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes, and curses; a frozen enemy takes twice the curse's extra damage.
hoarfrost.behindText: Leaves a hex circle of ice; enemies inside deal less damage and are slowed.
hoarfrost.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows curse you, and the curse lasts twice as long while you are chilled.

brimstone.name: Brimstone
brimstone.about: Hexing and Flame, melded. Damning fire.
brimstone.frontText: Fire damage that explodes, sets enemies burning and curses them; a cursed enemy burns hotter.
brimstone.behindText: Leaves a burning hex circle; enemies inside deal less damage and are set burning.
brimstone.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows curse you, and your burning lasts longer while you are cursed.

jinx.name: Jinx
jinx.about: Hexing and Lightning, melded. Bad luck that jumps from one to the next.
jinx.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; each arc carries the curse to the enemy it strikes.
jinx.behindText: Leaves a storm inside a hex circle; enemies inside deal less damage, and its bolts strike cursed enemies first.
jinx.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows curse you, and its arcs reach you from farther while you are cursed.

whisper.name: Whisper
whisper.about: Hexing and Swift, melded. A curse said quickly, again and again.
whisper.frontText: Faster to use again; curses what it hits, and hitting an enemy already cursed takes a little more off its wait.
whisper.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, enemies you pass close by are cursed.
whisper.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its blows curse you, and it moves faster still while you are cursed.

burden.name: Burden
burden.about: Hexing and Heavy, melded. A weight laid on the soul.
burden.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, and curses; the curse lasts twice as long on a stunned enemy.
burden.behindText: Leaves cracked ground inside a hex circle; enemies inside deal less damage, and those it staggers are cursed.
burden.monsterText: Its blows knock you back and curse you; you are knocked farther while you are cursed.

stasis.name: Stasis
stasis.about: Stilling and Power, melded. The blow is held, then lands again.
stasis.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that slows what it hits in time; when the slow ends, a quarter of the damage it took lands again.
stasis.behindText: Leaves a bubble where enemies and their shots crawl; while you stand in it, Power's damage bonus doesn't fade.
stasis.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows slow your cooldowns, and it hits harder the slower they are.

stagnation.name: Stagnation
stagnation.about: Stilling and Poison, melded. Still water goes bad.
stagnation.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons and slows what it hits in time; the poison on a slowed enemy doesn't wear off until the slow ends.
stagnation.behindText: Leaves a bubble that fills with poison; enemies crawl in it and are poisoned.
stagnation.monsterText: Poisons you; its blows slow your cooldowns, and your poison wears off more slowly.

frostlock.name: Frostlock
frostlock.about: Stilling and Frost, melded. Locked in ice and in time.
frostlock.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes, and slows what it hits in time; a slowed enemy freezes sooner and stays frozen longer (never a boss).
frostlock.behindText: Leaves a bubble of cold where enemies and their shots crawl; those that stay in it a while freeze (never a boss).
frostlock.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows slow your cooldowns too.

slowburn.name: Slow Burn
slowburn.about: Stilling and Flame, melded. A fire that takes its time.
slowburn.frontText: Fire damage that explodes, sets enemies burning and slows them in time; a slowed enemy burns twice as long, as hot.
slowburn.behindText: Leaves a bubble over burning ground; enemies crawl through the fire.
slowburn.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows slow your cooldowns, and your burning lasts longer.

stormglass.name: Stormglass
stormglass.about: Stilling and Lightning, melded. Lightning caught in the air, waiting.
stormglass.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs and slows what it hits in time; its arcs hang between slowed enemies and strike again when the slow ends.
stormglass.behindText: Leaves a bubble with a storm inside; its bolts strike everything the bubble holds.
stormglass.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows slow your cooldowns, and its shock lasts longer on you.

timeslip.name: Timeslip
timeslip.about: Stilling and Swift, melded. Their time slows, yours doesn't.
timeslip.frontText: Faster to use again; slows what it hits in time, and each slowed enemy near you takes a little more off its wait.
timeslip.behindText: Leaves a bubble where enemies crawl and you move faster.
timeslip.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its blows slow your cooldowns.

standstill.name: Standstill
standstill.about: Stilling and Heavy, melded. The stun that time forgot to end.
standstill.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; a stunned enemy is also slowed in time, so its stun lasts half as long again.
standstill.behindText: Leaves a bubble over cracked ground; enemies crawl through it and are staggered again and again.
standstill.monsterText: Its blows knock you back and slow your cooldowns.

shackle.name: Shackle
shackle.about: Binding and Power, melded. Hold it still, then hit it where it stands.
shackle.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that holds what it hits in place; your hits on a held enemy hit harder.
shackle.behindText: Leaves a snare that bites as it closes, hurting what it catches as well as holding it.
shackle.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows root you, and it hits harder while you are rooted.

strangler.name: Strangler
strangler.about: Binding and Poison, melded. Thorned vines that hold and sting.
strangler.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons and holds what it hits; poison bites twice as fast on a held enemy.
strangler.behindText: Leaves a snare of poisoned thorns; what it catches is held and poisoned.
strangler.monsterText: Poisons you; its blows root you, and you are poisoned faster while rooted.

icebound.name: Icebound
icebound.about: Binding and Frost, melded. Held fast by the ice.
icebound.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes, and holds what it hits; a held enemy chills twice as fast.
icebound.behindText: Leaves a snare of ice; what it catches is held, then frozen (never a boss).
icebound.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows root you, longer while you are chilled.

firetrap.name: Firetrap
firetrap.about: Binding and Flame, melded. The snare that catches fire.
firetrap.frontText: Fire damage that explodes, sets enemies burning and holds them; a held enemy burns hotter.
firetrap.behindText: Leaves a snare that bursts into flame when it catches an enemy, setting everything near it burning.
firetrap.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows root you, and you burn hotter while rooted.

tether.name: Tether
tether.about: Binding and Lightning, melded. Bound together by the bolt.
tether.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs and holds what it hits; while two held enemies are near, arcs leap between them again and again.
tether.behindText: Leaves a snare that, when it catches an enemy, sends a bolt to every enemy near it.
tether.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows root you, and it shocks you again while you are rooted.

lasso.name: Lasso
lasso.about: Binding and Swift, melded. Thrown fast, pulled tight.
lasso.frontText: Faster to use again; holds what it hits, and each use within a second of the last holds a little longer, up to three times.
lasso.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts, the first enemy you pass is caught in a snare.
lasso.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its blows root you.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.about: Binding and Heavy, melded. What it hits isn't going anywhere.
anchor.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; holds what it hits, and a held enemy is stunned twice as long.
anchor.behindText: Leaves a snare over cracked ground; what it catches is held and staggered.
anchor.monsterText: Its blows root you where you stand instead of knocking you back, and hit harder while you can't move.

confluence.name: Confluence
confluence.about: Pulling and Splitting, melded. The pieces fly out and drag it all back to one place.
confluence.frontText: Breaks into three copies that fly on; each drags what it hits back toward where the first one struck.
confluence.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out, then a vortex draws them back in, hitting again on the way.
confluence.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it; splits in two when it dies, and both halves drag you.

beckon.name: Beckon
beckon.about: Pulling and Hexing, melded. The curse calls them closer.
beckon.frontText: Curses what it hits and drags it toward where it struck; a cursed enemy is dragged twice as far.
beckon.behindText: Leaves a vortex inside a hex circle; what it draws in deals less damage.
beckon.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it and curse you.

horizon.name: Horizon
horizon.about: Pulling and Stilling, melded. The closer they come, the slower they move.
horizon.frontText: Drags what it hits toward where it struck and slows it in time when it gets there.
horizon.behindText: Leaves a vortex that slows in time whatever it draws in.
horizon.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it and slow your cooldowns.

reel.name: Reel
reel.about: Pulling and Binding, melded. Hooked, hauled in, held.
reel.frontText: Drags what it hits toward where it struck and holds it there.
reel.behindText: Leaves a snare with a vortex round it that draws enemies onto the snare.
reel.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it and root you there.

coven.name: Coven
coven.about: Splitting and Hexing, melded. Many voices saying one curse.
coven.frontText: Breaks into three copies that fly on and curse what they hit; an enemy cursed by two copies is cursed for twice as long.
coven.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out and each leaves a small hex circle where it lands.
coven.monsterText: Curses you; splits in two when it dies, both halves cursing.

constellation.name: Constellation
constellation.about: Splitting and Stilling, melded. The pieces hang in the air, then fall.
constellation.frontText: Breaks into three copies that hang still in the air for a moment, then fly at the nearest enemies and slow in time what they hit.
constellation.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out and stop in the air; whatever touches one is slowed in time.
constellation.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns; splits in two when it dies.

web.name: Web
web.about: Splitting and Binding, melded. Strands in every direction.
web.frontText: Breaks into three copies that fly on and hold what they hit; an enemy held by two copies is held twice as long.
web.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out and each leaves a small snare where it lands.
web.monsterText: Its blows root you; splits in two when it dies, both halves rooting.

torpor.name: Torpor
torpor.about: Hexing and Stilling, melded. A heavy, cursed sleep.
torpor.frontText: Curses what it hits and slows it in time; a cursed and slowed enemy takes more damage still.
torpor.behindText: Leaves a circle that hexes and stills; enemies inside crawl and deal less damage.
torpor.monsterText: Its blows curse you and slow your cooldowns.

witchknot.name: Witchknot
witchknot.about: Hexing and Binding, melded. A knot tied with a curse.
witchknot.frontText: Curses and holds what it hits; a held and cursed enemy takes more damage still.
witchknot.behindText: Leaves a snare inside a hex circle; what it catches is held and cursed.
witchknot.monsterText: Its blows curse you and root you.

amber.name: Amber
amber.about: Stilling and Binding, melded. Caught fast, and time stops around it.
amber.frontText: Holds what it hits and slows it in time, and the hold lasts as long as the slow.
amber.behindText: Leaves a snare inside a bubble; what it catches is held and slowed in time.
amber.monsterText: Its blows root you and slow your cooldowns.

backwash.name: Backwash
backwash.about: Pulling and Twin, melded. A pull, and a second before they find their feet.
backwash.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; each strike drags what it hits toward where it struck, and an enemy dragged by both is staggered.
backwash.behindText: Leaves a vortex that gives a second, sharp pull a moment after it forms.
backwash.monsterText: Attacks twice; each blow drags you toward it.

gullet.name: Gullet
gullet.about: Pulling and Leech, melded. Drag them close, and drink.
gullet.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, and again for every enemy it drags in.
gullet.behindText: Leaves a vortex; enemies that die in it drop life orbs.
gullet.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its blows drag you toward it.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.about: Pulling and Precise, melded. One line, one catch, one sure blow.
harpoon.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; drags what it hits toward where it struck, and an enemy dragged into the middle is marked: your next hit on it is a certain critical.
harpoon.behindText: Marks an enemy, and leaves a vortex that drags the marked one twice as hard.
harpoon.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; its blows drag you toward it.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.about: Pulling and Frenzied, melded. The faster you go, the harder it pulls.
whirlpool.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; each step of the frenzy drags from farther.
whirlpool.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; its vortex pulls harder for each step of the frenzy.
whirlpool.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows drag you toward it, farther the faster it is.

haven.name: Haven
haven.about: Pulling and Guarding, melded. Draw them in where you are safe.
haven.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield, stronger for each enemy it drags in.
haven.behindText: Leaves a ward circle with a vortex at its heart: you take less damage inside, and enemies are drawn in.
haven.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its blows drag you toward it.

eddy.name: Eddy
eddy.about: Pulling and Lasting, melded. A pull that will not let go.
eddy.frontText: Drags what it hits toward where it struck, and keeps drawing it there for two seconds after.
eddy.behindText: Leaves a vortex that lasts twice as long and pulls harder the longer it holds.
eddy.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its blows drag you toward it, and keep pulling a moment after.

whiplash.name: Whiplash
whiplash.about: Pulling and Fleeting, melded. A sudden, sharp yank.
whiplash.frontText: Drags what it hits toward where it struck in an instant, and those yanked in are staggered.
whiplash.behindText: Leaves a vortex that lasts a third as long and, as it goes, snaps everything inside to its middle.
whiplash.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; its blows yank you toward it.

maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
maelstrom.about: Pulling and Vast, melded. A pull that takes in everything.
maelstrom.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; drags what it hits from twice as far.
maelstrom.behindText: Leaves a vortex twice as wide.
maelstrom.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; its blows drag you toward it from farther.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.about: Splitting and Twin, melded. Cut one, two more grow.
hydra.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; both strikes break into copies that fly on, and the second breaks into four.
hydra.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out, and a moment later fly out again.
hydra.monsterText: Attacks twice; splits in two when it dies, and its halves attack twice.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.about: Splitting and Leech, melded. Every piece bites.
swarm.frontText: Breaks into three copies that fly on; each copy that hits heals you.
swarm.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out; an enemy a shard kills drops a life orb.
swarm.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; splits in two when it dies, and its halves heal as they hit.

shellburst.name: Shellburst
shellburst.about: Splitting and Volatile, melded. A bomb that breaks into bombs.
shellburst.frontText: Enemies it kills explode; breaks into three copies that burst where they hit.
shellburst.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out; each leaves a rune that detonates a moment later.
shellburst.monsterText: Splits in two when it dies, and each half explodes when it dies.

pinpoint.name: Pinpoint
pinpoint.about: Splitting and Precise, melded. Every piece finds the same weak point.
pinpoint.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; its three copies all fly at the toughest enemy near.
pinpoint.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out; the first enemy a shard hits is marked.
pinpoint.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; splits in two when it dies.

riot.name: Riot
riot.about: Splitting and Frenzied, melded. The faster you go, the more it breaks.
riot.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; at full frenzy it breaks into five copies, not three.
riot.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; each shard that kills adds a step.
riot.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; splits in two when it dies, and its halves are as fast as it was.

phalanx.name: Phalanx
phalanx.about: Splitting and Guarding, melded. Broken pieces of a shield, each still a shield.
phalanx.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; each copy that hits makes it stronger.
phalanx.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out; each leaves a small ward circle where it lands.
phalanx.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; splits in two when it dies, each half with a shield.

rebound.name: Rebound
rebound.about: Splitting and Lasting, melded. The pieces keep flying.
rebound.frontText: Breaks into three copies that fly on, and each flies on once more after it hits.
rebound.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out, and each bounces on once more to the nearest enemy.
rebound.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; splits in two when it dies, and its halves last longer.

flechette.name: Flechette
flechette.about: Splitting and Fleeting, melded. The pieces strike before you see them.
flechette.frontText: Breaks into three copies that fly twice as fast and strike a third harder.
flechette.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out twice as fast and twice as far.
flechette.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; splits in two when it dies, its halves quicker.

starburst.name: Starburst
starburst.about: Splitting and Vast, melded. Pieces everywhere.
starburst.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; breaks into five copies, not three.
starburst.behindText: Where it ends, twice as many shards fly out, twice as far.
starburst.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; splits in three when it dies.

refrain.name: Refrain
refrain.about: Hexing and Twin, melded. A curse spoken twice.
refrain.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; the second strike on a cursed enemy deepens the curse.
refrain.behindText: Leaves a hex circle, and a moment later a second one beside it.
refrain.monsterText: Attacks twice; its blows curse you, the second deeper.

bloodcurse.name: Bloodcurse
bloodcurse.about: Hexing and Leech, melded. Their weakness feeds you.
bloodcurse.frontText: Curses what it hits; hitting a cursed enemy heals you twice as much.
bloodcurse.behindText: Leaves a hex circle; enemies that die in it drop life orbs.
bloodcurse.monsterText: Heals when it hits you, twice as much while you are cursed; its blows curse you.

hexblast.name: Hexblast
hexblast.about: Hexing and Volatile, melded. A curse that bursts when they die.
hexblast.frontText: Curses what it hits; a cursed enemy it kills explodes, and the blast curses what it hits.
hexblast.behindText: Leaves a rune inside a hex circle; it detonates a moment later and curses what it hits.
hexblast.monsterText: Its blows curse you; explodes when it dies, and the blast curses you.

evileye.name: Evil Eye
evileye.about: Hexing and Precise, melded. A curse on one weak point.
evileye.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; curses what it hits, and your critical hits on a cursed enemy hit harder.
evileye.behindText: Marks an enemy; your next hit on it is a certain critical, and curses it.
evileye.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; its blows curse you.

delirium.name: Delirium
delirium.about: Hexing and Frenzied, melded. The weaker they are, the wilder you get.
delirium.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; hitting a cursed enemy adds a step.
delirium.behindText: Leaves a hex circle; while you fight inside it, your frenzy does not fade.
delirium.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt, faster while you are cursed; its blows curse you.

talisman.name: Talisman
talisman.about: Hexing and Guarding, melded. A charm for you, a curse for them.
talisman.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; enemies that strike it are cursed.
talisman.behindText: Leaves a ward circle inside a hex circle: you take less damage inside, and enemies in it deal less.
talisman.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; striking its shield curses you.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.about: Hexing and Lasting, melded. A curse that is never forgotten.
grudge.frontText: Curses what it hits for twice as long, and the curse deepens each second it holds.
grudge.behindText: Leaves a hex circle that lasts twice as long; enemies that leave it stay cursed.
grudge.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its curse on you lasts twice as long.

omen.name: Omen
omen.about: Hexing and Fleeting, melded. A curse that falls all at once.
omen.frontText: Curses what it hits; the curse is a third shorter but deeper.
omen.behindText: Leaves a hex circle that fades fast and, as it goes, curses everything inside, deeper.
omen.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; its curse on you is short but deep.

pall.name: Pall
pall.about: Hexing and Vast, melded. A curse over everything.
pall.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; curses what it hits, deeper for each other cursed enemy near, up to three.
pall.behindText: Leaves a hex circle twice as wide.
pall.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; its blows curse you.

rewind.name: Rewind
rewind.about: Stilling and Twin, melded. Time catches, and repeats.
rewind.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; the second strike on a slowed enemy slows it twice as long.
rewind.behindText: Leaves a bubble, and a moment later a second one beside it.
rewind.monsterText: Attacks twice; its blows slow your cooldowns.

sap.name: Sap
sap.about: Stilling and Leech, melded. Time drained away, life drawn out.
sap.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, twice as much for slowed enemies.
sap.behindText: Leaves a bubble; enemies that die in it drop life orbs.
sap.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its blows slow your cooldowns.

slowfuse.name: Slow Fuse
slowfuse.about: Stilling and Volatile, melded. A blast held in time.
slowfuse.frontText: Enemies it kills explode; a slowed enemy's blast waits a moment, then goes off twice as hard.
slowfuse.behindText: Leaves a rune inside a bubble; it detonates a moment later and slows in time what it hits.
slowfuse.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns; explodes when it dies, a moment late, and the blast slows you.

stillpoint.name: Stillpoint
stillpoint.about: Stilling and Precise, melded. Time slows, and the aim is true.
stillpoint.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; slows in time what it hits, and your hits on a slowed enemy are more often critical.
stillpoint.behindText: Marks an enemy and slows it in time.
stillpoint.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; its blows slow your cooldowns.

quickening.name: Quickening
quickening.about: Stilling and Frenzied, melded. Everything slows but you.
quickening.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; at full frenzy, its slow is twice as deep.
quickening.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; inside its bubble your frenzy builds twice as fast.
quickening.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows slow your cooldowns.

respite.name: Respite
respite.about: Stilling and Guarding, melded. Their blows arrive late.
respite.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; enemies that strike it are slowed in time.
respite.behindText: Leaves a ward circle inside a bubble: you take less damage inside, and their shots crawl.
respite.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its blows slow your cooldowns.

eternity.name: Eternity
eternity.about: Stilling and Lasting, melded. Time almost stops.
eternity.frontText: Slows in time what it hits for twice as long, and the slow deepens each second it holds.
eternity.behindText: Leaves a bubble that lasts twice as long.
eternity.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its slow on your cooldowns lasts twice as long.

stutter.name: Stutter
stutter.about: Stilling and Fleeting, melded. Time skips.
stutter.frontText: Slows in time what it hits, a third shorter but deeper; as the slow ends, the enemy is stunned for a moment.
stutter.behindText: Leaves a bubble that fades fast and, as it goes, stuns everything inside for a moment.
stutter.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; its slow on your cooldowns is short but deep.

doldrums.name: Doldrums
doldrums.about: Stilling and Vast, melded. Everything near grinds slow.
doldrums.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; slows in time what it hits and the enemies near it.
doldrums.behindText: Leaves a bubble twice as wide.
doldrums.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; its blows slow your cooldowns.

fetters.name: Fetters
fetters.about: Binding and Twin, melded. Two cuffs on one chain.
fetters.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; an enemy held by the first strike is held again by the second, half as long again.
fetters.behindText: Leaves a snare, and a moment later a second one beside it.
fetters.monsterText: Attacks twice; its blows root you.

thrall.name: Thrall
thrall.about: Binding and Leech, melded. Held fast, drained dry.
thrall.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, twice as much for held enemies.
thrall.behindText: Leaves a snare; what it catches is drained, healing you while it is held.
thrall.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its blows root you.

tripwire.name: Tripwire
tripwire.about: Binding and Volatile, melded. Caught, then blown apart.
tripwire.frontText: Holds what it hits; a held enemy it kills explodes twice as hard.
tripwire.behindText: Leaves a snare that explodes when it catches something.
tripwire.monsterText: Explodes when it dies; its blows root you.

pin.name: Pin
pin.about: Binding and Precise, melded. Held still, struck true.
pin.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; holds what it hits, and your first hit on a held enemy is a certain critical.
pin.behindText: Marks the enemy its snare catches.
pin.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; its blows root you.

mauler.name: Mauler
mauler.about: Binding and Frenzied, melded. Hold them and keep hitting.
mauler.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; hitting a held enemy adds a step.
mauler.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; an enemy its snare catches adds a step.
mauler.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows root you.

stockade.name: Stockade
stockade.about: Binding and Guarding, melded. Hold the line.
stockade.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield, stronger for each enemy it holds.
stockade.behindText: Leaves a snare inside a ward circle.
stockade.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its blows root you.

manacle.name: Manacle
manacle.about: Binding and Lasting, melded. Bound for good.
manacle.frontText: Holds what it hits for twice as long.
manacle.behindText: Leaves a snare that lasts twice as long, and holds what it catches twice as long.
manacle.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its blows root you twice as long.

snag.name: Snag
snag.about: Binding and Fleeting, melded. A quick catch.
snag.frontText: Holds what it hits for a third less time; a held enemy takes more damage.
snag.behindText: Leaves a snare that fades fast but catches everything that crosses it while it lasts.
snag.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; its blows root you briefly.

dragnet.name: Dragnet
dragnet.about: Binding and Vast, melded. Everything caught at once.
dragnet.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; holds what it hits and the enemies near it.
dragnet.behindText: Leaves a snare twice as wide that catches the next three enemies to cross it.
dragnet.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; its blows root you.

cinderbrood.name: Cinderbrood
cinderbrood.about: Reaping and Flame, melded. What burns, rises burning.
cinderbrood.frontText: Sets enemies burning; kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns, and an enemy that dies burning passes its fire to those near it.
cinderbrood.behindText: Kills raise an imp in place of a spirit: it keeps its distance and hurls fireballs that set enemies burning.
cinderbrood.monsterText: Its blows burn you; when it dies, it rises as an imp that hurls fireballs at you for a few seconds.

wintergrave.name: Wintergrave
wintergrave.about: Reaping and Frost, melded. The cold keeps what it kills.
wintergrave.frontText: Chills, then freezes; kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns, and an enemy that dies frozen shatters, chilling those near it.
