wintergrave.behindText: Kills raise a rimeling in place of a spirit: it flings icicles that chill, then freeze.
wintergrave.monsterText: Its blows slow you; when it dies, it rises as a rimeling that flings icicles at you for a few seconds.

stormwake.name: Stormwake
stormwake.about: Reaping and Lightning, melded. Every death a thunderclap.
stormwake.frontText: Arcs to nearby enemies; kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns, and each soul looses a bolt at the nearest enemy.
stormwake.behindText: Kills raise a stormwisp in place of a spirit: it darts in and zaps, each zap jumping on to a second enemy.
stormwake.monsterText: Its blows shock you; when it dies, it rises as a stormwisp that darts at you and zaps you for a few seconds.

bogborn.name: Bogborn
bogborn.about: Reaping and Poison, melded. What rots, breeds.
bogborn.frontText: Poisons; kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns, and an enemy that dies poisoned bursts, poisoning those near it.
bogborn.behindText: Kills raise a blight toad in place of a spirit: it hops after enemies and spits venom, and when its time is up it bursts in a cloud of poison.
bogborn.monsterText: Its blows poison you; when it dies, it rises as a blight toad that spits venom at you and bursts in a cloud of poison.

charnel.name: Charnel
charnel.about: Reaping and Power, melded. The dead, made strong.
charnel.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; kills leave a soul that takes time off your cooldowns, and each soul gathered adds to your damage for a few seconds.
charnel.behindText: Kills raise a bonebrute in place of a spirit: slow and huge, it slams the ground, striking everything near it and throwing it back.
charnel.monsterText: It hits harder and has more life; when it dies, it rises as a bonebrute that stomps after you and slams the ground.

impaler.name: Impaler
impaler.about: Piercing and Power, melded. Every body it passes through only drives it harder.
impaler.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that goes on through everything in its path, carrying every enemy it runs through along on its point to the end of its line, where they are slammed into a heap that strikes everything round it, harder for each body.
impaler.behindText: Each hit that lands builds a short damage bonus; the lance of light spends the bonus, growing wider with each step of it, and drives a stake into the ground where it ends that bursts, wider for each step.
impaler.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its shots fly through walls, and each wall a shot goes through makes it bigger and harder.

stinger.name: Stinger
stinger.about: Piercing and Poison, melded. One sting, carried down the whole line.
stinger.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons and goes on through, each enemy taking one more dose than the one before it; the sting stays in the last one as a barb that swells green and bursts a moment later in a spray of venom over those round it.
stinger.behindText: The lance of light leaves a trail of poison cloud along its whole line.
stinger.monsterText: Poisons you; its shots fly through walls, and each one leaves a small cloud of poison where it lands.

icelance.name: Icelance
icelance.about: Piercing and Frost, melded. An icicle driven through a line of them.
icelance.frontText: Frost damage that goes on through; each enemy it goes through is chilled harder than the one before it, and the last in the line freezes.
icelance.behindText: The lance is ice: its whole line is left as a strip of ice that slows, and when the ice cracks a moment later it freezes whatever still stands on it.
icelance.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its shots fly through walls, and a second shot while you are slowed freezes you for a moment.

sunspear.name: Sunspear
sunspear.about: Piercing and Flame, melded. A spear of sunlight that sets the line ablaze.
sunspear.frontText: Fire damage that goes on through and sets everything in its line burning; when one of them dies burning, the fire runs down the line to the others, burning them harder.
sunspear.behindText: The lance lands as a beam of fire and leaves its whole line as burning ground.
sunspear.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its shots fly through walls and leave a line of fire on the ground behind them.

stormlance.name: Stormlance
stormlance.about: Piercing and Lightning, melded. A lightning rod thrust through them.
stormlance.frontText: Lightning damage that goes on through; where its line ends it forks, arcing to every enemy near the last one it struck.
stormlance.behindText: The lance is a bolt of lightning: after it strikes down its line, it arcs out to every enemy near the line.
stormlance.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its shots fly through walls, and one that passes close by arcs to you.

dart.name: Dart
dart.about: Piercing and Swift, melded. Quick, thin and through.
dart.frontText: Faster to use again; each enemy it goes through takes a little more time off its wait, and the dart comes back to your hand, striking everything on its way back.
dart.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed, and a moment later the lance of light strikes down the path you ran in it.
dart.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster still; its shots fly through walls, and it darts a step aside after each shot.

batteringram.name: Battering Ram
batteringram.about: Piercing and Heavy, melded. One great blow that bowls through them all.
batteringram.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; it goes on through everything in its line, knocking each enemy aside out of its path, stunned.
batteringram.behindText: The lance falls like a beam of iron and cracks the ground along its whole line, staggering what walks on it.
batteringram.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; its shots fly through walls and knock you back too.

pitchfork.name: Pitchfork
pitchfork.about: Piercing and Twin, melded. Two prongs, two lines.
pitchfork.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; the second goes through along a line beside the first, the two spreading apart like the prongs of a fork.
pitchfork.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later: a second lance strikes across the first, the two crossing where the move ended.
pitchfork.monsterText: Attacks twice; its shots fly through walls two at a time, side by side.

bloodlance.name: Bloodlance
bloodlance.about: Piercing and Leech, melded. It drinks from every life it runs through.
bloodlance.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, twice for each it goes through after the first, and the last in its line is burst open, its life left on the ground as a life orb for you.
bloodlance.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs; the lance of light draws every orb on its line straight to you.
bloodlance.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its shots fly through walls, trailing blood, and heal the other monsters they pass through on the way.

fuse.name: Fuse
fuse.about: Piercing and Volatile, melded. It leaves a charge in everything it goes through.
fuse.frontText: Goes on through, leaving a small charge in each enemy in its line; a moment later they go off one after another down the line, and those killed explode.
fuse.behindText: The lance of light leaves a string of runes along its line that go off one after another, from you outward.
fuse.monsterText: Explodes when it dies, and the blast flies on through walls in a line toward you.

bodkin.name: Bodkin
bodkin.about: Piercing and Precise, melded. A narrow point that finds the gap in every one.
bodkin.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; it goes on through, a sight snapping onto each enemy it passes, and the last in its line takes a certain critical that bursts out of its back in a spray of steel shards, striking those behind it.
bodkin.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical; the lance of light strikes down the line to the marked enemy, wherever it stands, and that is the hit.
bodkin.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; its shots fly through walls and through your shield, and a shot that strikes your shield shatters it.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.about: Piercing and Frenzied, melded. The faster you go, the deeper it reaches.
barrage.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; with each step of the frenzy it goes on through a tile farther, and at full frenzy it strikes its line again and again in a rattling volley, once for each step.
barrage.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; at full frenzy every lance strikes twice.
barrage.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its shots fly through walls, and once it is badly hurt it looses them in fans of three.

spearwall.name: Spearwall
spearwall.about: Piercing and Guarding, melded. A line of spears to stand behind.
spearwall.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield, stronger for every enemy it goes through, and a row of spears springs up across its line for a few seconds: enemies that run onto them are struck and thrown back.
spearwall.behindText: The lance of light leaves a wall of light along its line for a few seconds; enemies' shots that meet it are stopped.
spearwall.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; while the shield holds, its shots fly through walls, and when you break it, it staggers.

longspear.name: Longspear
longspear.about: Piercing and Lasting, melded. A line that lingers.
longspear.frontText: Goes on through half as far again, and its line stays a moment after: any enemy that walks into it is struck too.
longspear.behindText: The lance of light stays standing for a second and a half, striking whatever crosses it.
longspear.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its shots fly through walls, and what they leave on you lasts longer still.

flicker.name: Flicker
flicker.about: Piercing and Fleeting, melded. There and gone before they see it.
flicker.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter and does as much in that time; its whole line flashes twice, a blink apart, the second flash striking it again, and on the second flash you blink to the end of the line.
flicker.behindText: The lance of light strikes at once, with no moment's wait, flicks back down its line toward you, striking again, and is ready to strike again sooner.
flicker.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; its shots fly through walls a third faster, each followed a moment later by a flickering copy of itself on the same path.

broadspear.name: Broadspear
broadspear.about: Piercing and Vast, melded. A swath, not a line.
broadspear.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; the line it goes on through is three times as wide.
broadspear.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits; the lance of light is as wide as a road, and its hits splash too.
broadspear.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; its shots fly through walls, and are wide.

gaff.name: Gaff
gaff.about: Piercing and Pulling, melded. Run them through, then haul them in.
gaff.frontText: Goes on through, then drags everything in its line back to the first enemy it struck, the whole line pulled together.
gaff.behindText: Leaves a vortex at the far end of the lance's line; the lance drags everything it strikes into the vortex.
gaff.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it; its shots fly through walls and drag you a step toward it.

trident.name: Trident
trident.about: Piercing and Splitting, melded. One point in, three points out.
trident.frontText: Goes through the first enemy it strikes, then breaks into three copies that each go on through a line of their own.
trident.behindText: Where the lance ends, shards fly out in every direction, and each goes through everything it meets.
trident.monsterText: Splits in two when it dies; its shots split into three as they pass through a wall.

witchpin.name: Witchpin
witchpin.about: Piercing and Hexing, melded. One pin through a line of curses.
witchpin.frontText: Curses what it hits and goes on through, stitching every enemy in its line together with a black thread of the curse: a hit on any one of them stings all the others on the thread.
witchpin.behindText: The lance of light leaves its line as a strip of hex: enemies standing on it deal less damage, and each that crosses it is pinned in place for a moment by a black needle.
witchpin.monsterText: Its blows curse you, so you take more damage; its shots fly through walls, and while you are cursed they turn in the air to follow you.

sundial.name: Sundial
sundial.about: Piercing and Stilling, melded. The shadow of a needle, laid across time.
sundial.frontText: What it hits is slowed in time; it goes on through, slowing each enemy in its line more than the one before, and the last stands still for a moment.
sundial.behindText: The lance of light leaves its line as a band of slow time: enemies and their shots crawl as they cross it.
sundial.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns; its shots fly through walls and slow them too.

skewer.name: Skewer
skewer.about: Piercing and Binding, melded. Pinned in a row.
skewer.frontText: Holds the enemies it hits in place; everything in its line is pinned together, held longer the more of them there are.
skewer.behindText: The lance of light leaves its line as a snare: the first enemy to cross it is held fast.
skewer.monsterText: Its blows root you to the spot; its shots fly through walls and pin you where you stand.

gore.name: Gore
gore.about: Bleeding and Power, melded. A wound as deep as the blow was hard.
gore.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that throws what it hits back; the bleeding is as deep as the hit was hard, and runs harder while they stagger back.
gore.behindText: Each hit that lands builds a short damage bonus; its thorns grow bigger and sharper with each step of the bonus.
gore.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows make you bleed, harder the harder they hit.

gangrene.name: Gangrene
gangrene.about: Bleeding and Poison, melded. An open wound, and something in it.
gangrene.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons and makes them bleed; an enemy both poisoned and bleeding festers, each dose of poison making it bleed harder, and when it dies it bursts in a cloud of rot that poisons and bleeds those near it.
gangrene.behindText: Leaves thorns in a cloud of poison: whatever they cut is poisoned and festers, leaving puffs of rot behind it as it walks.
gangrene.monsterText: Poisons you and makes you bleed; while you bleed, its poison lasts longer, and when it dies it bursts in a cloud of rot where it falls.

rimeblood.name: Rimeblood
rimeblood.about: Bleeding and Frost, melded. Blood that freezes into spikes.
rimeblood.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes, and makes them bleed; a bleeding enemy that freezes has its blood freeze into spikes that burst out of it, cutting those near it.
rimeblood.behindText: Leaves thorns of ice that slow and cut whatever walks through.
rimeblood.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its blows make you bleed, and the bleeding runs cold, slowing you more.

bloodboil.name: Bloodboil
bloodboil.about: Bleeding and Flame, melded. The blood boils in the wound.
bloodboil.frontText: Fire damage that explodes, sets them burning and makes them bleed; an enemy both burning and bleeding boils: as it moves it spatters burning blood on those near it, setting them burning.
bloodboil.behindText: Leaves thorns on burning ground: whatever walks through is cut and set burning.
bloodboil.monsterText: Deals fire damage, sets you burning and makes you bleed; while you burn, you bleed harder.

galvanic.name: Galvanic
galvanic.about: Bleeding and Lightning, melded. A jolt that makes them jerk and tear.
galvanic.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; every enemy an arc strikes bleeds, and jerks a step with the jolt, bleeding harder for it.
galvanic.behindText: Leaves thorns charged with lightning: whatever they cut is struck, and the strike arcs on to one near it.
galvanic.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its blows make you bleed, and each shock tears the wound wider.

lacerate.name: Lacerate
lacerate.about: Bleeding and Swift, melded. Cut after cut, faster than they close.
lacerate.frontText: Faster to use again; each hit on an enemy already bleeding opens another cut on it that shows, up to three, and the third makes the cuts burst open, striking it hard and making those beside it bleed.
lacerate.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed, and while it lasts you leave thorns along your path.
lacerate.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; each of its quick blows opens your wound deeper, and at the third your wound gapes and sprays, and every monster near comes for you faster.

mangle.name: Mangle
mangle.about: Bleeding and Heavy, melded. A crushing blow that tears when it lets go.
mangle.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; when the stun ends the wound tears open, and its first steps bleed three times as hard.
mangle.behindText: Leaves cracked ground thick with thorns: what is staggered there is cut.
mangle.monsterText: Its blows knock you back and make you bleed; being thrown back tears the wound, and you bleed harder for it.

fangs.name: Fangs
fangs.about: Bleeding and Twin, melded. Two bites, one wound.
fangs.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; the second bite reopens the first's wound, and the bleeding doubles.
fangs.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later: a second ring of thorns springs up round the first.
fangs.monsterText: Attacks twice; each bite makes you bleed, and the second doubles it.

bloodfeast.name: Bloodfeast
bloodfeast.about: Bleeding and Leech, melded. Every drop they lose comes to you.
bloodfeast.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit; everything they bleed streams to you as drops of blood that heal you as they land, and once you are whole, the blood hardens round you into a red shield.
bloodfeast.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs; it leaves a pool of blood ringed with thorns: bleeding enemies near it are drained into it in red streams, and it heals you while you stand in it.
bloodfeast.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; your blood streams to it as you bleed, and each drink makes its next blow harder.

bloodburst.name: Bloodburst
bloodburst.about: Bleeding and Volatile, melded. A body full of blood, ready to burst.
bloodburst.frontText: Enemies it kills explode; a bleeding enemy that dies bursts in a spray of blood that makes everyone near it bleed.
bloodburst.behindText: Leaves a rune ringed by thorns; when it goes off, the thorns are flung out in every direction.
bloodburst.monsterText: Explodes when it dies, and the blast makes you bleed.

artery.name: Artery
artery.about: Bleeding and Precise, melded. One sure cut, in the right place.
artery.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; a critical hit opens an artery: the enemy bleeds three times as hard, and its blood jets out behind it in a line, making everything the jet reaches bleed.
artery.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical; when it lands, the marked enemy's blood bursts out all round it and opens an artery in every enemy it splashes.
artery.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; every third hit opens your artery: your blood jets out, and you bleed three times as hard for a moment.

bloodrage.name: Bloodrage
bloodrage.about: Bleeding and Frenzied, melded. The smell of blood drives you on.
bloodrage.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; every bleeding enemy near you keeps the frenzy from fading, and at full frenzy each hit on a bleeding enemy sprays its blood in an arc that cuts those beside it.
bloodrage.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; at full frenzy, thorns spring up wherever you strike.
bloodrage.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows make you bleed, harder the faster it goes, and while you bleed it smells your blood and comes for you faster.

thornshield.name: Thornshield
thornshield.about: Bleeding and Guarding, melded. A shield with thorns on its face.
thornshield.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield bristling with thorns; while it holds, whatever strikes you bleeds, and when it breaks, its thorns burst out all round you, cutting everything near.
thornshield.behindText: Leaves a ward circle edged with thorns: you take less damage inside, whatever crosses its edge is cut, and the thorns lash out at any enemy that strikes you while you stand in it.
thornshield.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; striking its shield makes you bleed, and when you break it, its thorns burst out at you.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.about: Bleeding and Lasting, melded. A wound that will not close.
hemorrhage.frontText: The bleeding lasts half as long again and grows the longer it runs; once it has grown full, the wound ruptures, spraying blood that makes everyone near it bleed, and opens again, fresh.
hemorrhage.behindText: Its thorns last half as long again and spread as they stand, growing wider the longer they last.
hemorrhage.monsterText: Its bleeding on you lasts longer and grows the longer it runs; once it has grown full, the wound ruptures and opens again, fresh.

papercut.name: Papercut
papercut.about: Bleeding and Fleeting, melded. Many small, quick cuts.
papercut.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter and does as much in that time; each hit on an enemy already bleeding cuts it again at once, and the cut flies on as a paper-thin blade to the nearest other enemy that is bleeding.
papercut.behindText: Its thorns burst out as a flurry of paper blades spinning outward from where it ended, cutting everything they pass twice as often, and gone a third sooner.
papercut.monsterText: Its poison, burning and bleeding hurt you faster; each of its blows leaves a paper cut on you, up to five, and every cut opens again each time you are struck.

bramble.name: Bramble
bramble.about: Bleeding and Vast, melded. A whole thicket of thorns.
bramble.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; the bleeding spreads: an enemy bleeding from it makes those it touches bleed too.
bramble.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits; its thorns grow into a wide thicket.
bramble.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider, and every one makes you bleed.

fishhook.name: Fishhook
fishhook.about: Bleeding and Pulling, melded. Hooked, and hauled in by the wound.
fishhook.frontText: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck; being dragged tears them, and they bleed hard all the way in.
fishhook.behindText: Leaves a vortex lined with thorns: everything drawn into it is cut.
fishhook.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it, and the drag makes you bleed.

thornspray.name: Thornspray
thornspray.about: Bleeding and Splitting, melded. Thorns that scatter and take root.
thornspray.frontText: Breaks into three smaller copies that fly on to other enemies; each makes what it hits bleed, opens one already bleeding wider, and leaves a patch of thorns taking root under it.
thornspray.behindText: Where it ends, thorns fly out in every direction and take root where they land, each a small patch of thorns.
thornspray.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed; when it dies it splits in two, and the split bursts in a spray of thorns that cuts you if you are near.

bloodhex.name: Bloodhex
bloodhex.about: Bleeding and Hexing, melded. A curse in the blood that will not stop.
bloodhex.frontText: Curses what it hits, so it takes more damage from everything; a cursed enemy's bleeding never stops while the curse holds, and its blood drips into hex circles under it as it goes: enemies standing in them deal less damage.
bloodhex.behindText: Leaves a hex circle grown over with thorns: enemies inside deal less damage and are cut, and any enemy that dies in it spills a new circle where it fell.
bloodhex.monsterText: Its blows curse you and make you bleed; while you are cursed the bleeding does not stop, and a ring of hex follows under your feet, slowing you.

clot.name: Clot
clot.about: Bleeding and Stilling, melded. The blood held still, then let go.
clot.frontText: What it hits is slowed in time, and its bleeding is held back; when the slow ends, all of it pours out at once.
clot.behindText: Leaves a bubble of slow time full of thorns: whatever crawls through is cut over and over.
clot.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns and make you bleed.

briar.name: Briar
briar.about: Bleeding and Binding, melded. Caught in the briars, torn to get out.
briar.frontText: Holds the enemies it hits in place; when the hold breaks, they tear free and bleed hard.
briar.behindText: Leaves a snare of briars: the next enemy to cross it is held fast and cut.
briar.monsterText: Its blows root you to the spot; tearing free makes you bleed.

wraithstep.name: Wraithstep
wraithstep.about: Reaping and Swift, melded. The dead run with you.
wraithstep.frontText: Faster to use again; each soul you gather gives you a burst of speed, and leaves a grey afterimage of you where you stood, which strikes the nearest enemy before it fades.
wraithstep.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed, and while it lasts your spirits move and strike as fast as you.
wraithstep.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; when it dies it rises once, fast, and comes straight for you.

tombstone.name: Tombstone
tombstone.about: Reaping and Heavy, melded. Death lands like a stone.
tombstone.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; a kill's soul falls to the ground with a thud that staggers the enemies near it, then flies to you.
tombstone.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that is slow and heavy: its blows stun.
tombstone.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; when it dies it rises once, and slams the ground as it gets up.

revenants.name: Revenants
revenants.about: Reaping and Twin, melded. Every death comes back twice.
revenants.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; a kill leaves two souls.
revenants.behindText: Kills raise two spirits side by side, each weaker.
revenants.monsterText: Attacks twice; when it dies it rises as two, each half as strong.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.about: Reaping and Leech, melded. The dead feed you.
ghoul.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit; where a kill falls, a ghoul's maw opens in the ground and bites the enemies near it, and each bite heals you.
ghoul.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs; kills raise a spirit that feeds: every blow it lands sends a stream of blood to you, healing you.
ghoul.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; when it dies it rises once, and every blow it lands then heals it and the monsters near it.

soulburst.name: Soulburst
soulburst.about: Reaping and Volatile, melded. The soul goes up with the body.
soulburst.frontText: Enemies it kills explode, and the soul bursts out with the blast, striking those near it, and still takes time off your waits.
soulburst.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that bursts when its time is up, striking everything round it.
soulburst.monsterText: Explodes when it dies, then rises once from the blast.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.about: Reaping and Precise, melded. Spirits that never miss.
deadeye.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; a kill by a critical hit leaves a bright soul that takes twice the time off, and stays a while as an eye over you that marks the nearest enemy each second: your next hit on a marked one is a certain critical.
deadeye.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical; each time you mark one, every spirit you have fires a bright shot at it from wherever it stands, a certain critical, then goes for it.
deadeye.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; when it dies it rises once, and a bright eye opens over it: while it stands, the monsters near it strike you harder, finding the gaps.

macabre.name: Macabre
macabre.about: Reaping and Frenzied, melded. A dance with the dead.
macabre.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; each soul you gather adds a step of frenzy, and at full frenzy each kill's corpse jerks up and dances a moment among its kin, striking them.
macabre.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; your spirits strike faster for each step of it, and at full frenzy they catch its flames, moving and striking twice as fast.
macabre.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; when it dies it rises once, already at its fastest, and its frenzy spreads: the monsters near it speed up too.

gravewarden.name: Gravewarden
gravewarden.about: Reaping and Guarding, melded. The dead stand guard.
gravewarden.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; each soul you gather stays as a shade circling you, up to three, and each shade takes the next blow that would strike you.
gravewarden.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that stands guard by you: while it is near, you take less damage, and it hauls back to it any enemy that comes at you.
gravewarden.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; when it dies it rises once, its shield whole again, and a shade circles it that takes the first blow you land on it every few seconds.

undying.name: Undying
undying.about: Reaping and Lasting, melded. Death does not keep them down.
undying.frontText: Each soul takes half as much time again off your waits, and where each kill falls, a dead hand bursts from the ground a moment later, seizes the nearest enemy and drags it half under, stunned.
undying.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that fights half as long again, and when its time is up it rises once more.
undying.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; when it dies it rises once, with half as much life again, and when it falls again a dead hand bursts from the ground under you and holds you.

fetch.name: Fetch
fetch.about: Reaping and Fleeting, melded. The soul is yours the moment they fall.
fetch.frontText: Each soul comes to you the instant its enemy falls, leaping on through the enemies near it first and striking each, a leap more for every other kill in the second before.
fetch.behindText: Kills raise a spirit for a third less time that strikes half as often again, darting on to the next enemy after each blow.
fetch.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; when it dies it rises once, briefly and fast, and blinks to your side as it rises.

legion.name: Legion
legion.about: Reaping and Vast, melded. An army of the dead.
legion.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; each soul flies to you through the enemies near it, striking them on its way.
legion.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits; kills raise a spirit whose blows strike everything round what it hits.
legion.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; when it dies it rises once, and its attacks reach wider still.

gravewell.name: Gravewell
gravewell.about: Reaping and Pulling, melded. A well the dead fall into.
gravewell.frontText: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck; a kill's soul drags those near it to where it fell.
gravewell.behindText: Leaves a vortex; any enemy that dies in it, by anyone's hand, rises as your spirit.
gravewell.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it; when it dies it rises once, and drags you in.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.about: Reaping and Splitting, melded. Restless spirits that throw things.
poltergeist.frontText: Breaks into three smaller copies that fly on to other enemies; each soul a kill leaves hurls a shard at the nearest enemy on its way to you.
poltergeist.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out in every direction; kills raise a spirit that hurls shards at what it fights.
poltergeist.monsterText: Splits in two when it dies, and each half rises once.

haunting.name: Haunting
haunting.about: Reaping and Hexing, melded. A curse that walks after death.
haunting.frontText: Curses what it hits; a cursed enemy that dies leaves a ghost that flies to the nearest enemy and haunts it: it is cursed, and the ghost's wail throws the enemies round it back.
haunting.behindText: Leaves a hex circle; kills raise a spirit trailing a black shroud: enemies it passes are cursed.
haunting.monsterText: Its blows curse you; when it dies it rises once, and while it is risen its ghost follows you, wailing: you stay cursed and slowed.

limbo.name: Limbo
limbo.about: Reaping and Stilling, melded. Caught between one moment and the next.
limbo.frontText: What it hits is slowed in time; where a kill's soul rises, time slows for a moment round it.
limbo.behindText: Kills raise a spirit wrapped in a bubble of slow time that goes with it: enemies near it crawl.
limbo.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns; when it dies it hangs a moment between death and life, then rises once, slowing your cooldowns while it stands.

gravebind.name: Gravebind
gravebind.about: Reaping and Binding, melded. The dead hold them down.
gravebind.frontText: Holds the enemies it hits in place; a kill's soul binds the nearest enemy where it stands.
gravebind.behindText: Kills raise a spirit whose blows hold what they strike in place.
gravebind.monsterText: Its blows root you to the spot; when it dies it rises once, and roots you as it rises.

guillotine.name: Guillotine
guillotine.about: Culling and Power, melded. The blade falls with all its weight.
guillotine.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; an enemy it culls is struck so hard its body is thrown, striking those it lands among.
guillotine.behindText: Leaves a reaper's mark that falls like a blade: it culls the first weak enemy to cross it, and strikes everything near it hard.
guillotine.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; while you are low, its blows throw you back.

nightshade.name: Nightshade
nightshade.about: Culling and Poison, melded. It counts the poison still to come.
nightshade.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; an enemy whose poison would finish it dies now.
nightshade.behindText: Leaves a cloud of poison: any enemy in it that falls nearly dead dies outright.
nightshade.monsterText: Poisons you; while you are low, its poison hurts you more.

coldcut.name: Coldcut
coldcut.about: Culling and Frost, melded. The frozen break.
coldcut.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; an enemy it culls while chilled or frozen shatters into shards of ice that chill those near it.
coldcut.behindText: Leaves ice that slows; a weak enemy that slips on it is culled and shatters.
coldcut.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; while you are low, its blows freeze you for a moment.

cremate.name: Cremate
cremate.about: Culling and Flame, melded. Nothing left but ash.
cremate.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; an enemy it culls goes up in a column of flame that sets those near it burning.
cremate.behindText: Leaves burning ground; a weak enemy standing in it is burned to ash.
cremate.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; while you are low, its burning hurts you more.

smite.name: Smite
smite.about: Culling and Lightning, melded. A bolt that seeks the weak.
smite.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; each arc culls what it strikes, and an arc that culls jumps on again.
smite.behindText: Leaves a storm that strikes; each strike culls the weak enemy it hits.
smite.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; while you are low, each of its blows brings a bolt down on you too.

coup.name: Coup
coup.about: Culling and Swift, melded. Strike, and strike again at once.
coup.frontText: Faster to use again; a cull takes this move's whole wait away, and you dash to the nearest enemy, ready to strike again.
coup.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed, and each cull gives you another; while it lasts, every enemy you run past is cut.
coup.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; while you are low, it rushes straight at you in a blur, leaving afterimages behind.

crusher.name: Crusher
crusher.about: Culling and Heavy, melded. The killing blow shakes the ground.
crusher.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; a cull lands with a quake that stuns the enemies near it.
crusher.behindText: Leaves cracked ground that staggers enemies; a weak enemy staggered there is culled.
crusher.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; while you are low, they stun you too.

scissors.name: Scissors
scissors.about: Culling and Twin, melded. Two cuts, one after the other.
scissors.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; each cull is followed a moment later by a second cut at the weakest enemy near it.
scissors.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later: a second reaper's mark beside the first.
scissors.monsterText: Attacks twice; while you are low, its second blow lands harder.

bloodprice.name: Bloodprice
bloodprice.about: Culling and Leech, melded. Their last life is yours.
bloodprice.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit; a cull splits the life the enemy had left: half flies to you and heals you, half bursts out of the body as a red blast that strikes the enemies near it.
bloodprice.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs; its reaper's mark takes a price: when it culls an enemy, every enemy near the mark loses as much life as the culled one had left, in a red flash.
bloodprice.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; while you are low, your blood streams to it as it strikes, and it heals twice as much.

deathburst.name: Deathburst
deathburst.about: Culling and Volatile, melded. A death that takes others with it.
deathburst.frontText: Enemies it kills explode, and the blast culls the weak it strikes.
deathburst.behindText: Leaves a rune that detonates a moment later; a weak enemy that lives through the blast is culled by it.
deathburst.monsterText: Explodes when it dies, harder while you are low.

mercy.name: Mercy
mercy.about: Culling and Precise, melded. A narrow blade, for the end.
mercy.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; a critical hit culls from twice as high, and every cull sets a sight on the weakest enemy near it: your next hit on that one is a certain critical.
mercy.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical; once the marked enemy is nearly dead, the mark culls it wherever it stands, and passes to the weakest enemy near it.
mercy.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; while you are low, a sight hangs over you and every one of its hits finds a gap.

massacre.name: Massacre
massacre.about: Culling and Frenzied, melded. Each kill quickens the next.
massacre.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; each cull adds two steps of frenzy, and a cull at full frenzy sets off a whirl of blades round you that strikes everything near.
massacre.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; while the frenzy is full, every kill leaves a reaper's mark where it fell.
massacre.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; while you are low, every monster that dies near it drives it into a red frenzy: faster, and harder hitting.

lastrites.name: Last Rites
lastrites.about: Culling and Guarding, melded. A shield from the fallen.
lastrites.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; each cull adds to it, and the rites are said over it: while it holds, the next enemy to strike you is struck down if it is weak, and thrown back if not.
lastrites.behindText: Leaves a ward circle: you take less damage inside, and weak enemies that step into it are culled; the ward grows wider with each it takes.
lastrites.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; while you are low, its shield grows back, and when it dies its shield passes to the monster nearest it.

deathwatch.name: Deathwatch
deathwatch.about: Culling and Lasting, melded. The reaper waits.
deathwatch.frontText: A reaper's shadow stands over each enemy it hits for a few seconds: if anything brings that enemy nearly dead while it watches, the shadow's scythe falls and it dies outright.
deathwatch.behindText: Its reaper's mark lasts half as long again and creeps toward the weakest enemy near it, taking two enemies, not one.
deathwatch.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; while you are low, a reaper's shadow stands over you and they last twice as long.

quietus.name: Quietus
quietus.about: Culling and Fleeting, melded. Quick, and not just one.
quietus.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter and does as much in that time; a cull leaves a brief reaper's mark where it fell.
quietus.behindText: Its reaper's mark lasts a third less time, but is not spent: it takes every weak enemy that crosses it while it lasts.
quietus.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; while you are low, all that is left of them lands at once.

purge.name: Purge
purge.about: Culling and Vast, melded. The more it strikes, the more it takes.
purge.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; it culls from higher up the more enemies it hits at once, and when one blow culls three or more, a white light floods out from you that culls every weak enemy in sight.
purge.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits; its reaper's mark is three times as wide.
purge.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; while you are low, each of its blows sends a ring out all the way round it.

gallows.name: Gallows
gallows.about: Culling and Pulling, melded. Hauled up to the rope.
gallows.frontText: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck; the weak ones dragged there are culled where they meet.
gallows.behindText: Leaves a vortex; a weak enemy drawn to its heart is culled.
gallows.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it; while you are low, it drags you farther.

decimate.name: Decimate
decimate.about: Culling and Splitting, melded. One kill makes three more blows.
decimate.frontText: Breaks into three smaller copies that fly on to other enemies, each culling what it leaves nearly dead; a copy that culls splits into three again.
decimate.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out in every direction, and each culls the weak enemy it strikes.
decimate.monsterText: Splits in two when it dies; while you are low, both halves hit harder.

condemn.name: Condemn
condemn.about: Culling and Hexing, melded. The curse passes to the next.
condemn.frontText: Curses what it hits; a cursed enemy it culls passes its curse on to the nearest enemy.
condemn.behindText: Leaves a hex circle: enemies inside deal less damage, and weak ones still in it when it ends are culled.
condemn.monsterText: Its blows curse you; while you are low, its curse on you is worse.

finalhour.name: Final Hour
finalhour.about: Culling and Stilling, melded. The nearer death, the slower time.
finalhour.frontText: What it hits is slowed in time, more the nearer it is to death; one nearly dead stands still, and dies.
finalhour.behindText: Leaves a bubble of slow time; a weak enemy inside does not crawl but stops still, until the reaper's mark at the bubble's heart takes it.
finalhour.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns; while you are low, they slow them more.

noose.name: Noose
noose.about: Culling and Binding, melded. The tighter it holds, the weaker they get.
noose.frontText: Holds the enemies it hits in place; the hold tightens, taking a little of their life each second, and one that falls nearly dead dies.
noose.behindText: Leaves a snare: a weak enemy caught in it is culled.
noose.monsterText: Its blows root you to the spot; while you are low, they root you longer.

upheaval.name: Upheaval
upheaval.about: Surging and Power, melded. The ground heaves them into the air.
upheaval.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; every third use the shockwave throws the enemies it strikes into the air, and each lands on those beneath it, striking them.
upheaval.behindText: Each hit that lands builds a short damage bonus; your dodge's surge spends it, striking harder for each step.
upheaval.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its shockwave throws you back.

pestilence.name: Pestilence
pestilence.about: Surging and Poison, melded. A wave that spreads the sickness.
pestilence.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; every third use the shockwave spreads the poison: each poisoned enemy it strikes passes its doses on to those near it.
pestilence.behindText: Your dodge releases a surge of poison, leaving a cloud where you dodged from.
pestilence.monsterText: Poisons you; its shockwave poisons you too.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.about: Surging and Frost, melded. A storm of hail round you.
blizzard.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; every third use calls down hail round you for two seconds, chilling, then freezing.
blizzard.behindText: Your dodge leaves a ring of frost on the ground that freezes the first enemies to cross it.
blizzard.monsterText: Deals frost damage and slows you; its shockwave chills you.

nova.name: Nova
nova.about: Surging and Flame, melded. A ring of fire.
nova.frontText: Fire damage that explodes and sets enemies burning; every third use the shockwave is a ring of fire that sets everything burning, and those already burning explode.
nova.behindText: Your dodge leaves a ring of burning ground where you dodged from.
nova.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its shockwave is a ring of fire.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.about: Surging and Lightning, melded. A crack of thunder, and bolts from the sky.
thunderclap.frontText: Lightning damage that arcs to nearby enemies; every third use the shockwave is thunder: a bolt strikes each enemy it touches, and arcs on.
thunderclap.behindText: Your dodge releases a surge, and leaves a storm over where you dodged from.
thunderclap.monsterText: Deals lightning damage and shocks you; its shockwave shocks you.

rush.name: Rush
rush.about: Surging and Swift, melded. The wave carries you with it.
rush.frontText: Faster to use again; every third use you surge forward with the shockwave, through the enemies in your path, striking them.
rush.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; your dodge goes twice as far, and surges at both ends.
rush.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; after its shockwave, it charges at you.

seismic.name: Seismic
seismic.about: Surging and Heavy, melded. The ground splits.
seismic.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; every third use the ground cracks open in lines out from you, staggering what stands on them.
seismic.behindText: Your dodge lands with a slam that stuns the enemies near where you land.
seismic.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; its shockwave cracks the ground and staggers you.

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.about: Surging and Twin, melded. A quake, and its aftershock.
tremor.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; every third use the shockwave comes twice, the second wider, a moment after.
tremor.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later: your dodge's surge comes again where you land.
tremor.monsterText: Attacks twice; its shockwave comes twice.

heartbeat.name: Heartbeat
heartbeat.about: Surging and Leech, melded. Every pulse brings life back.
heartbeat.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit; every third use the shockwave throbs red: each enemy it strikes bleeds a stream of blood back to you that heals you.
heartbeat.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs; your dodge's surge draws every life orb near you to you, and each bursts on its way as a small surge, striking the enemies near it.
heartbeat.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its shockwave throbs red, healing it and every monster it washes over.

overload.name: Overload
overload.about: Surging and Volatile, melded. Every one it touches is primed.
overload.frontText: Enemies it kills explode; every third use the shockwave leaves a rune on each enemy it strikes, which goes off a moment later.
overload.behindText: Your dodge leaves a rune where you dodged from, which goes off as a surge.
overload.monsterText: Explodes when it dies; its shockwave leaves a rune under you.

lens.name: Lens
lens.about: Surging and Precise, melded. The wave, focused into a beam.
lens.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; every third use the shockwave gathers into a beam straight ahead of you, far stronger, and a certain critical.
lens.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical; your dodge's surge flies to the marked enemy and bursts there.
lens.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; so does its shockwave.

crescendo.name: Crescendo
crescendo.about: Surging and Frenzied, melded. Louder and louder.
crescendo.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; the shockwave grows with each step of the frenzy, and at full frenzy comes every second use.
crescendo.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; at full frenzy, each dodge surges twice.
crescendo.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its shockwaves come faster as it is hurt.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.about: Surging and Guarding, melded. The wave becomes a wall.
bastion.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; every third use the shockwave adds to it for each enemy it strikes, and stands round you as a ring of walls of light for a few seconds: enemies that reach it are thrown back, and their shots break on it.
bastion.behindText: Your dodge leaves a ward circle where you land: you take less damage inside, and your landing throws every enemy inside the circle out of it.
bastion.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its shockwave makes the shield whole again, and shields every monster it washes over.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.about: Surging and Lasting, melded. A note that rings on.
resonance.frontText: Everything it makes lasts half as long again; every third use the shockwave hangs in the air round you as a ring that strikes whatever crosses it for a few seconds.
resonance.behindText: Your dodge's surge rings on where you dodged from, striking again each second for a few seconds.
resonance.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its shockwave rings on, striking again a moment later.

spark.name: Spark
spark.about: Surging and Fleeting, melded. Small and often.
spark.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is a third shorter and does as much in that time; a smaller shockwave every second use, and each one throws off sparks that leap to the nearest enemies, striking them.
spark.behindText: Your dodge releases a quick surge, is ready again a third sooner, and leaves a trail of crackling sparks along its path that strike what crosses them.
spark.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; its shockwaves come oftener and smaller, and each throws a spark at you.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.about: Surging and Vast, melded. A wave that rolls across the room.
tsunami.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; every third use the shockwave rolls out across the room as a wave, carrying the enemies it strikes before it.
tsunami.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits; your dodge's surge is three times as wide.
tsunami.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider; its shockwave rolls out far wider.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.about: Surging and Pulling, melded. The wave draws back, taking them with it.
undertow.frontText: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck; every third use the shockwave goes out, then draws back to you, dragging everything it struck along with it.
undertow.behindText: Your dodge leaves a vortex where you dodged from.
undertow.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it; its shockwave pulls you in.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.about: Surging and Splitting, melded. The wave throws your blow out three ways.
ricochet.frontText: Breaks into three smaller copies that fly on to other enemies; every third use the shockwave throws three more copies of your blow at the nearest enemies.
ricochet.behindText: Your dodge's surge throws shards out in every direction.
ricochet.monsterText: Splits in two when it dies; its shockwave flings shards at you.

hexwave.name: Hexwave
hexwave.about: Surging and Hexing, melded. A wave of curses.
hexwave.frontText: Curses what it hits; every third use the shockwave curses everything it strikes, and staggers any enemy that was cursed already.
hexwave.behindText: Your dodge leaves a hex circle where you dodged from.
hexwave.monsterText: Its blows curse you; its shockwave curses you.

lull.name: Lull
lull.about: Surging and Stilling, melded. Time slows round you.
lull.frontText: What it hits is slowed in time; every third use the shockwave leaves time slowed round you for two seconds, a bubble that goes where you go.
lull.behindText: Your dodge leaves a bubble of slow time where you dodged from.
lull.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns; its shockwave slows them too.

tangle.name: Tangle
tangle.about: Surging and Binding, melded. A ring of snares.
tangle.frontText: Holds the enemies it hits in place; every third use the shockwave leaves a ring of snares round you.
tangle.behindText: Your dodge's surge holds in place every enemy it strikes.
tangle.monsterText: Its blows root you to the spot; its shockwave roots you.

harrow.name: Harrow
harrow.about: Piercing and Bleeding, melded. A spiked line dragged through them.
harrow.frontText: Goes on through everything in its path, and spikes erupt from the ground under each enemy it runs through, cutting it and those beside it; an enemy run through bleeds hard even standing still.
harrow.behindText: The lance of light leaves its whole line as a row of thorns.
harrow.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed; its shots fly through walls, and a shot that passes close by rakes you, making you bleed even while you stand still.

wraithspear.name: Wraithspear
wraithspear.about: Piercing and Reaping, melded. The soul flies on down the line.
wraithspear.frontText: Goes on through everything in its path; a kill's soul flies on down the line, striking those beyond, before it comes to you.
wraithspear.behindText: Kills raise a spirit that hurls lances of light down its line at what it fights.
wraithspear.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls; when it dies it rises once, and shoots at you through the walls as it rises.

deathblow.name: Deathblow
deathblow.about: Piercing and Culling, melded. Through the whole line, finishing each.
deathblow.frontText: Goes on through everything in its path, culling each one it leaves nearly dead; each cull carries it a tile farther.
deathblow.behindText: The lance of light culls every weak enemy on its line.
deathblow.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls; while you are low, they hit much harder.

breakthrough.name: Breakthrough
breakthrough.about: Piercing and Surging, melded. A shockwave in a straight line.
breakthrough.frontText: Goes on through everything in its path; every third use the shockwave is not a ring but a wave rolling straight down its line, as far as the room goes.
breakthrough.behindText: Your dodge releases a surge, and a lance of light down the way you dodged.
breakthrough.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls; its shockwave rolls through walls to reach you.

bloodharvest.name: Bloodharvest
bloodharvest.about: Bleeding and Reaping, melded. What bleeds out, rises.
bloodharvest.frontText: Makes what it hits bleed; an enemy that bleeds to death rises at once as a spirit that fights for you for a few seconds, and its red soul takes twice the time off.
bloodharvest.behindText: Kills raise a spirit whose blows make what they strike bleed; a blow on an enemy already bleeding tears the wound, splashing its blood on those round it, and they bleed too.
bloodharvest.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed; when it dies it rises once, and if you are bleeding, a second, small one rises from your blood beside it.

butcher.name: Butcher
butcher.about: Bleeding and Culling, melded. Cut down, and cut apart.
butcher.frontText: Makes what it hits bleed; an enemy it culls is cut apart, flinging blood on those near it, and they bleed hard.
butcher.behindText: Leaves thorns that cull any weak enemy they cut.
butcher.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed; while you are low, you bleed harder.

bloodwave.name: Bloodwave
bloodwave.about: Bleeding and Surging, melded. A wave that tears every wound open.
bloodwave.frontText: Makes what it hits bleed; every third use the shockwave tears every wound open: each bleeding enemy it strikes takes all its bleeding at once.
bloodwave.behindText: Your dodge leaves a ring of thorns where you dodged from.
bloodwave.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed; its shockwave tears your wound open, all of it at once.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.about: Reaping and Culling, melded. Every cull feeds the reaper.
harvest.frontText: Enemies its hit leaves nearly dead die outright, and each one culled is reaped: a scythe sweeps round where it fell, culling every enemy there that is nearly dead, and each culled leaves a soul that takes twice the time off.
harvest.behindText: Whatever the reaper's mark takes rises as your spirit.
harvest.monsterText: Hits much harder while you are low; when it dies it rises once, and while it stands, the souls of the monsters that die near it fly into it, healing it.

soulstorm.name: Soulstorm
soulstorm.about: Reaping and Surging, melded. The dead ride the wave.
soulstorm.frontText: Kills leave souls; every third use the shockwave carries out with it the souls you gathered in the last few seconds, each striking the enemies it passes.
soulstorm.behindText: Your dodge's surge raises every enemy it kills as your spirit.
soulstorm.monsterText: Rises once after it dies; its shockwave comes again from where it rises.

deathknell.name: Deathknell
deathknell.about: Culling and Surging, melded. The bell tolls for the weak.
deathknell.frontText: Every third use the shockwave tolls: it culls every weak enemy it strikes.
deathknell.behindText: Your dodge leaves a ringing bell where you dodged from: for a few seconds it tolls each second, culling the weak enemies round it.
deathknell.monsterText: Hits much harder while you are low; so does its shockwave.

twin2.name: Twin II
twin2.about: Two Twin, melded: Twin at level 2.
twin2.frontText: Strikes, fires or bursts three times, each a little weaker.
twin2.behindText: Repeats itself twice, each repeat weaker.

leech2.name: Leech II
leech2.about: Two Leech, melded: Leech at level 2.
leech2.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, half as much again.
leech2.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs more often.
leech2.monsterText: Heals when it hits you, half as much again.

volatile2.name: Volatile II
volatile2.about: Two Volatile, melded: Volatile at level 2.
volatile2.frontText: Enemies it kills explode, half as big and hard again.
volatile2.behindText: Leaves a rune that detonates half as big and hard again.
volatile2.monsterText: Explodes when it dies, half as hard again.

precise2.name: Precise II
precise2.about: Two Precise, melded: Precise at level 2.
precise2.frontText: More damage still, a smaller area still.
precise2.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next two hits on it are certain criticals.
precise2.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour, half as much again.

frenzied2.name: Frenzied II
frenzied2.about: Two Frenzied, melded: Frenzied at level 2.
frenzied2.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, each step half as big again, up to five times.
frenzied2.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, half as long again.
frenzied2.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt, half as much again.

guarding2.name: Guarding II
guarding2.about: Two Guarding, melded: Guarding at level 2.
guarding2.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield, half as big again.
guarding2.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you take even less damage.
guarding2.monsterText: Carries a shield half as big again.

lasting2.name: Lasting II
lasting2.about: Two Lasting, melded: Lasting at level 2.
lasting2.frontText: Everything it makes and gives lasts twice as long.
lasting2.behindText: Everything it makes and gives lasts twice as long.
lasting2.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer still on you.

fleeting2.name: Fleeting II
fleeting2.about: Two Fleeting, melded: Fleeting at level 2.
fleeting2.frontText: Everything it makes and gives is half as long, and does as much in that time.
fleeting2.behindText: Everything it makes and gives is half as long, and does as much in that time.
fleeting2.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster still.

vast2.name: Vast II
vast2.about: Two Vast, melded: Vast at level 2.
vast2.frontText: An even bigger area, a little less damage.
vast2.behindText: Each hit splashes harder onto the enemies near what it hits.

swift2.name: Swift II
swift2.about: Two Swift, melded: Swift at level 2.
swift2.frontText: Faster to use again, half as much again.
swift2.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed, half as big again.
swift2.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster, half as much again.

heavy2.name: Heavy II
heavy2.about: Two Heavy, melded: Heavy at level 2.
heavy2.frontText: Slower, hits harder still, and stuns half as long again.
heavy2.behindText: Leaves wider cracked ground that staggers longer.
heavy2.monsterText: Its blows knock you back farther.

pulling2.name: Pulling II
pulling2.about: Two Pulling, melded: Pulling at level 2.
pulling2.frontText: Drags the enemies it hits toward where it struck, from half as far again.
pulling2.behindText: Leaves a vortex half as wide and strong again.
pulling2.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it, half as far again.

splitting2.name: Splitting II
splitting2.about: Two Splitting, melded: Splitting at level 2.
splitting2.frontText: Breaks into four copies instead of three, each a little stronger.
splitting2.behindText: Half as many shards again, flying farther.
splitting2.monsterText: Splits in three when it dies.

hexing2.name: Hexing II
hexing2.about: Two Hexing, melded: Hexing at level 2.
hexing2.frontText: Its curse is half as strong again.
hexing2.behindText: Its hex circle is half as wide and strong again.
hexing2.monsterText: Its curse on you is half as strong again.

stilling2.name: Stilling II
stilling2.about: Two Stilling, melded: Stilling at level 2.
stilling2.frontText: What it hits is slowed in time half as much again.
stilling2.behindText: Its bubble is half as wide again and lasts half as long again.
stilling2.monsterText: Its blows slow your cooldowns half as much again.

binding2.name: Binding II
binding2.about: Two Binding, melded: Binding at level 2.
binding2.frontText: Holds the enemies it hits half as long again.
binding2.behindText: Its snare catches the next two enemies to cross it.
binding2.monsterText: Its blows root you half as long again.

piercing2.name: Piercing II
piercing2.about: Two Piercing, melded: Piercing at level 2.
piercing2.frontText: Goes on through half as far again.
piercing2.behindText: Its lance of light is half as long and strong again.
piercing2.monsterText: Its shots fly through walls, half as strong again.

bleeding2.name: Bleeding II
bleeding2.about: Two Bleeding, melded: Bleeding at level 2.
bleeding2.frontText: Makes what it hits bleed half as hard again.
bleeding2.behindText: Its thorns are half as wide and sharp again.
bleeding2.monsterText: Its blows make you bleed half as hard again.

reaping2.name: Reaping II
reaping2.about: Two Reaping, melded: Reaping at level 2.
reaping2.frontText: Each soul takes half as much time again off your waits.
reaping2.behindText: Its spirits fight half as long and hard again.
reaping2.monsterText: When it dies it rises once, half as strong again.

culling2.name: Culling II
culling2.about: Two Culling, melded: Culling at level 2.
culling2.frontText: Culls enemies from half as high again.
culling2.behindText: Its reaper's mark is half as wide again, and culls from half as high again.
