ambush.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; the first hit on an enemy that hasn't been hurt yet is a certain critical and catches it off guard: it reels, stunned for a moment, and those beside it flinch back a step.
ambush.behindText: Marks an enemy for only a moment, a ring of light closing in round it; strike it before the ring closes and the certain critical does double damage, and the ring bursts outward, striking those near it.
ambush.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour. Until it first strikes you it lurks, half faded from sight, and its first blow comes in a sudden lunge from out of reach, always critical.

berserk.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each use makes the next faster and harder, up to five times, and at a full frenzy each blow lands in a red shockwave that throws back everything near where it hits.
berserk.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and each kill adds to Power's damage bonus and lets out a roar that drives the enemies near you back.
berserk.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; hits harder and has more life. Badly hurt, it swells red with rage, and its blows throw you back.

blight.frontText: The hit is not weakened, and poison bites harder the lower the enemy's life; an enemy that dies poisoned withers away into a patch of black blight that poisons whatever crosses it.
blight.behindText: Poisoned enemies take more damage from everything, and each hit on a poisoned one throws off a puff of rot that poisons those beside it.
blight.monsterText: While its poison is on you, every blow from it is harder, and the poison boils up round you in a black cloud that hurts you while you stand in it.

bulwark.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each use gives you a brief shield, and while it holds each use drives the shield's face forward in a wave of force that throws back the enemies before you.
bulwark.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it Power's damage bonus builds twice as fast, and raised shields ring its edge: enemies that walk into them are knocked back out.
bulwark.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; hits harder and has more life. While its shield holds, it charges at you behind it and shoves you back as it reaches you.

canker.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; its poison lasts twice as long and doesn't wear off while you keep hitting, and sores break out on what it poisons: every few seconds one bursts, splashing poison on those beside it.
canker.behindText: Leaves a poison cloud that lasts twice as long; whatever dies in it rots where it fell into a fresh cloud of its own.
canker.monsterText: Its poison lasts longer on you and doesn't wear off while it keeps hitting you; each blow lays a sore on you that bursts a few seconds later, poisoning you again.

delirium.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; hitting a cursed enemy adds a step, and at a full frenzy a cursed enemy you strike goes mad, flailing at the enemies beside it.
delirium.behindText: Leaves a hex circle; while you fight inside it your frenzy does not fade, and each kill inside it lets out a shriek that curses every enemy near.
delirium.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt, faster while you are cursed; its blows curse you, and while you are cursed it raves, darting at you in sudden wild dashes.

doom.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that curses; each hit on a cursed enemy deepens its curse, up to three times, and at the third, doom falls: a great dark hammer drops on it from above, striking it and those beside it hard.
doom.behindText: Leaves a hex circle where enemies deal less damage; each hit you land on an enemy inside builds Power's damage bonus twice as fast, and an enemy that dies inside is crushed into the ground by a falling weight that staggers and curses those beside it.
doom.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows curse you, and at its third blow a shadow of doom gathers over you and falls a moment later: step out from under it.

duelist.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; an enemy with no other enemy near it always takes a critical hit, and is challenged: crossed blades flash over it, and it is held to the spot.
duelist.behindText: Marks an enemy; the marked one takes more damage from everything until the mark is spent, and a ring of light stands round it: other enemies that step inside are thrown out.
duelist.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its hits find the gaps in your armour. When you are alone with it, it salutes, blades crossed over it, then lunges at you from afar, every hit critical.

eternity.frontText: Slows in time what it hits for twice as long, and the slow deepens each second it holds; as the slow runs out, time stops for it: it stands still a moment, a clock's face over it (never a boss).
eternity.behindText: Leaves a bubble that lasts twice as long; a clock's hand sweeps round inside it, and whatever the hand passes over is stopped for a moment.
eternity.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its slow on your cooldowns lasts twice as long, and its blows stop you dead for a moment, a clock's face over you.

evileye.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; curses what it hits, your critical hits on a cursed enemy hit harder, and a critical on a cursed one opens an evil eye over it: while the eye stares, every enemy near it is cursed.
evileye.behindText: Marks an enemy with an eye that follows it: your next hit on it is a certain critical and curses it, and as the critical lands the eye bursts, cursing everything near.
evileye.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; its blows curse you, and it stares: while you are near it, a dark beam runs from its eye to you, cursing you.

fervor.frontText: Each kill makes you attack faster and burn hotter for a few seconds, and flares up where it fell, setting the enemies near it burning.
fervor.behindText: Each kill quickens you and your fire a little; while quickened, each use throws off sparks that set the nearest enemies burning.
fervor.monsterText: Each monster that dies near it feeds it: it flares up in fire, its fire hotter, and its next blow leaves the ground round you burning.

fever.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; each use while frenzied adds one more dose, up to five, and at a full frenzy the poison boils over: what you hit sweats a green haze that poisons those beside it.
fever.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and a poisoned enemy dying holds it twice as long; its fever runs into you as it dies, a green pulse that lifts your frenzy a step.
fever.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; poisons you. Hurt, it sweats poison, a haze left where it stands that poisons you as you cross it.

fury.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times, and the frenzy fades one step at a time instead of all at once; at a full frenzy a red fury burns round you, striking the enemies that stand close.
fury.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going twice as long, and each kill leaves an ember of fury where it fell: walk over it and your frenzy climbs a step.
fury.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt, and once fast it stays fast; badly hurt, it roars, red steam rising off it, and charges you.

glide.frontText: Faster to use again; frost damage that chills, each chilled enemy it hits gives you a little speed, and after each use you skate, leaving a trail of ice that chills what crosses it.
glide.behindText: Leaves ice that slows enemies but speeds you while you stand on it; while on it you slide, and enemies you slide past are chilled and knocked aside.
glide.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; deals frost damage and slows you. It lays a strip of ice where it goes, which chills you as you cross it.

grudge.frontText: Curses what it hits for twice as long, and the curse deepens each second it holds; after three of your blows on a cursed enemy the grudge is sealed: a dark sigil burns on it, and each blow you land on it strikes it again a moment later.
grudge.behindText: Leaves a hex circle that lasts twice as long; an enemy that leaves it stays cursed, and a black chain follows it back to the circle, dragging at it.
grudge.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its curse on you lasts twice as long. It holds a grudge: strike it and a red mark burns over you, and its next blow on you lands twice as hard.

haymaker.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that lands sooner, with less wind-up; what it hits is knocked flying, thrown far back into what stands behind it, which is struck too.
haymaker.behindText: Power's damage bonus builds twice as fast and fades in half the time; at its full, your blow lands with a thunderous crack, a ring of dust that staggers everything near.
haymaker.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its blows come with less warning, and every third is a haymaker that knocks you down, stunned for a moment.

hourglass.frontText: Everything it puts on enemies lasts half again as long, and every poison, burn or chill on you wears off a third sooner; an hourglass turns over each enemy it hits, and when its sand runs out all that is left of its poison and burning strikes at once.
hourglass.behindText: What it leaves on the ground lasts half again as long and works a third faster; an hourglass stands in it, and as its sand runs out the ground flares up once more, striking everything inside.
hourglass.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you and hurt you faster too; an hourglass hangs over you while they last, and when its sand runs out all that is left of them strikes you at once.

lamprey.frontText: Strikes twice; both blows heal you, the second twice as much, and the second bite latches on: a red line from it to you drains it into you for a moment after.
lamprey.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, and what it hits is left bitten: for a few seconds drops of its life fly back to you.
lamprey.monsterText: Attacks twice; heals when it hits you, its second blow twice as much, and its second bite latches on: a red line drains your life into it until you get away from it.

lancet.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; heals you for every enemy hit, and a critical hit lances it: a thin beam of red light runs from it to you, healing you three times as much, and the cut bleeds.
lancet.behindText: Marks an enemy, a small blade hanging over it; your certain critical on it drives the blade in, and for a few seconds the blade drains the enemy into you.
lancet.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its hits find the gaps in your armour, and every third blow lances you: a thin red beam runs from you to it, and you bleed.

manacle.frontText: Holds what it hits for twice as long, and the manacle stays on: when the hold ends, a chain still runs from it to the floor where it was held, and it can't go farther than the chain's length.
manacle.behindText: Leaves a snare that lasts twice as long and holds what it catches twice as long; when it catches, manacles snap shut on every enemy near it, chained to it.
manacle.monsterText: Its poison, burning and chill last longer on you; its blows root you twice as long, and clap a manacle on you: a chain runs from you to it, and you can't go farther from it than the chain's length.

mauler.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; hitting a held enemy adds a step, and at a full frenzy your blow tears a held enemy loose and flings it into the nearest other enemy, striking both.
mauler.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; an enemy its snare catches adds a step, and the snare's chain whips out and drags the nearest other enemy onto it too.
mauler.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows root you, and while you are rooted it mauls you in a flurry of quick blows.

momentum.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit; each hit that lands makes the next a little harder, the build-up holding until you go three seconds without landing one, and at its full each blow rolls on as a shockwave through the enemies before you.
momentum.behindText: Power's damage bonus lasts half again as long and builds two steps higher; at its height a heavy drumbeat booms out from you, staggering everything near.
momentum.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; each blow it lands makes its next harder, and every third it barrels into you, knocking you flying.

needle.frontText: A weaker hit that poisons; a critical hit puts three doses on at once and leaves the needle in it, spraying its poison in a fine mist over those beside it.
needle.behindText: Marks an enemy: your next hit on it is a certain critical and doubles the poison already on it, and the poison bursts out of it in green needles that fly at the nearest enemies, poisoning them.
needle.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; poisons you. Its critical hits poison you three times over, and every third blow leaves a needle in you that stings again a few seconds later.

onrush.frontText: Faster to use again; more damage and a bigger hit, half again as hard while a burst of speed is on you, and with speed on you each use carries you forward in a rush, bowling aside the enemies in your way.
onrush.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed; while it lasts Power's damage bonus doesn't fade, and enemies you run into are bowled aside.
onrush.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; hits harder and has more life. Its first blow after running at you hits half again as hard, coming in a headlong rush that bowls you over.

pin.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; holds what it hits, and your first hit on a held enemy is a certain critical that drives a spike through it into the floor, holding it twice as long.
pin.behindText: Marks the enemy its snare catches, and a spike of light drives down through it, holding it and the enemies beside it for a moment.
pin.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; its blows root you, a spike driven through your shadow holding you longer.

quickdraw.frontText: Faster to use again; the first use after two seconds without using it is a certain critical, drawn in a flash: a gleam of steel, and the blow reaches a step farther.
quickdraw.behindText: Marks an enemy; landing the marked critical gives you a burst of speed and shortens its cooldown, and the blow glances on to the next enemy, a certain critical too.
quickdraw.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Its first blow after a pause is critical, drawn so fast you see only the gleam as it strikes from out of reach.

quickening.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times; at full frenzy its slow is twice as deep, and each use sends out a ripple of slowed time from you, slowing every enemy near.
quickening.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going; inside its bubble your frenzy builds twice as fast, and each kill there makes the bubble pulse, slowing everything inside deeper.
quickening.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its blows slow your cooldowns, and as it speeds up it leaves afterimages behind it that lash out at you.

rapier.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; each use makes the next faster, the higher the frenzy the more often it lands a critical hit, and each critical thrusts on through: a line of light runs through it to the enemy behind, striking that too.
rapier.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, a critical kill adds two steps to it, and with a flourish a slash of light sweeps round you, striking all near.
rapier.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; its hits find the gaps in your armour, the more hurt it is the more often critical, and once hurt it lunges through you, carrying it past you to your far side.

reverb.frontText: Strikes twice, and every poison, burn, chill or shock it leaves lasts half again as long for each blow that lands; each blow rings, and its echo strikes the enemies beside it a moment later.
reverb.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, and what the repeat leaves lasts twice as long; the repeat rings out from where it lands, throwing the enemies near back a step.
reverb.monsterText: Attacks twice; its poison, burning and chill last longer on you with every blow that lands, and each blow rings on in you: a moment later its echo strikes you again, weaker.

riposte.frontText: Each use gives you a brief shield; whatever strikes the shield, your next hit on it is a certain critical, and the shield answers at once: a flashing blade strikes back at whatever struck it.
riposte.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; your hits on enemies inside it are critical more often, and an enemy that strikes you while you are inside is answered by a blade of light from the circle's edge.
riposte.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its hits find the gaps in your armour. Strike its shield and it answers at once with a quick counter-thrust, and its next blow on you is critical.

siphon.frontText: Your poison heals you while it eats them: a thin green thread runs from each enemy it poisons to you, carrying its life to you while the poison lasts.
siphon.behindText: Your poison heals you a little, and an enemy that dies poisoned breaks into green motes that fly to you, healing you.
siphon.monsterText: While its poison is on you, you heal less, and a green thread runs from you to it, carrying your life to it.

stillpoint.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; slows in time what it hits, your hits on a slowed enemy are critical more often, and a critical on a slowed one cracks it like glass: shards of stilled time fly off it, slowing those they strike.
stillpoint.behindText: Marks an enemy and slows it in time, and a ring of stilled air stands round it: enemies that step into it are slowed too.
stillpoint.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour; its blows slow your cooldowns, and every third blow stops you still for a moment.

sunder.frontText: Stunned enemies take extra damage, and a hit on a stunned enemy sunders it: its guard cracks open, plates flying off, and it takes more from your blows for a few seconds.
sunder.behindText: Stunned enemies take a little extra damage, and the ground cracks under each enemy you stun: enemies that step on the crack are stunned too.
sunder.monsterText: Its next blow soon after one that knocked you back is harder, and sunders your guard: plates fly off you, and its blows land harder for a few seconds.

tailwind.frontText: Faster to use again; each use also gives a burst of speed that lasts while you keep using it, and while it lasts a wind at your back blows the enemies behind you away.
tailwind.behindText: Each use gives you a burst of speed that lasts half again as long, and gusts trail behind you, pushing back the enemies that follow.
tailwind.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster and stays fast long after each blow; the wind at its back throws grit at you as it comes, slowing you.

tempo.frontText: Strikes twice, and both blows add to the frenzy, so it builds twice as fast; every fifth blow lands on the beat, a drumbeat ring bursting out round you that strikes everything near.
tempo.behindText: Repeats itself a moment later, and the repeat's kills keep the frenzy going too; at a full frenzy it repeats twice.
tempo.monsterText: Attacks twice; speeds up as it is hurt, every blow it lands speeding it up a little more, and every third blow falls on the beat, staggering you.

timeslip.frontText: Faster to use again; slows what it hits in time, each slowed enemy near you takes a little off its wait, and you slip through time: after each use you blink a step on, leaving a fading afterimage of you that strikes what it touches.
timeslip.behindText: Leaves a bubble where enemies crawl and you move faster; inside it you leave afterimages as you move, which strike the enemies they touch.
timeslip.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; its blows slow your cooldowns, and it slips through time, vanishing and stepping out again beside you.

transfusion.frontText: Heals you for every enemy hit, and the healing keeps coming in over the next few seconds, half again as much in all; the blood you draw gathers in a red orb over you, and every third hit it bursts, healing you and striking those near.
transfusion.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs that last much longer and heal over a few seconds, and each orb pulses, healing you while you stand near it.
transfusion.monsterText: Heals when it hits you, and keeps healing for a few seconds after, red threads of life running into it from the monsters near it.

vendetta.frontText: More damage, a smaller area; a critical hit marks the enemy for vengeance with a red sigil, every hit on it more likely to be critical until it dies, and when it dies the vendetta passes to the nearest enemy.
vendetta.behindText: Marks an enemy until it dies: every third hit on it is a certain critical, landing in a burst of crossed slashes.
vendetta.monsterText: Its hits find the gaps in your armour. Every third blow marks you with a red sigil, and its blows land harder while the mark lasts.

windward.frontText: Faster to use again; each use gives you a brief shield, while it holds you move faster, and a whirl of wind round you blows back the enemies that come close.
windward.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; inside it you move faster and take less damage, and a wind blows outward from its edge, pushing back the enemies coming in.
windward.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; moves and attacks faster, faster still while its shield holds, and the wind round it blows you back when you come close.

amber.frontText: Holds what it hits and slows it in time, the hold lasting as long as the slow; the held enemy is sealed in amber, and when the amber breaks it shatters, striking those near.
amber.behindText: Leaves a snare inside a bubble; what it catches is sealed in amber, and the enemies near it stick to the amber's edge, slowed.
amber.monsterText: Its blows root you and slow your cooldowns, sealing your feet in amber that cracks away when the hold ends.

beckon.frontText: Curses what it hits and drags it toward where it struck, a cursed one twice as far: a hand of shadow reaches out and hauls it in, and the enemies it is hauled to are cursed too.
beckon.behindText: Leaves a vortex inside a hex circle; what it draws in deals less damage, and hands of shadow rise from its middle to hold what reaches it for a moment.
beckon.monsterText: Its blows drag you toward it and curse you; while you are cursed, a hand of shadow reaches out from it every few seconds and hauls you in again.

bedrock.frontText: Slower, hits much harder, and its stun lasts half again as long; the blow drives what it stuns into the ground, and a ring of rock bursts up round it, throwing back those beside it.
bedrock.behindText: Leaves cracked ground that lasts until the fight is over, and every so often a stone juts up from it under an enemy, striking and staggering it.
bedrock.monsterText: Its blows knock you back and you stay staggered longer; every second blow, rock bursts up under your feet, staggering you again.

blink.frontText: Faster to use again, and for a moment after each use you move very fast, a streak of light behind you, and the enemies you pass through are cut.
blink.behindText: Each use gives a burst of speed a third as long and much faster, and as it ends you flash, a burst of light that dazzles the enemies near you for a moment.
blink.monsterText: Moves and attacks faster; darts at you in short, very fast bursts, a streak of light that cuts you as it passes through you.

bloodcurse.frontText: Curses what it hits; hitting a cursed enemy heals you twice as much, and the curse bleeds it: dark drops of its life fly from it to you.
bloodcurse.behindText: Leaves a hex circle; enemies that die in it drop life orbs, and the circle drinks: each enemy standing in it bleeds a dark thread of life to you.
bloodcurse.monsterText: Heals when it hits you, twice as much while you are cursed; its blows curse you, and while you are cursed your life drips from you to it in dark drops.

bloodlust.frontText: More damage and a bigger hit that heals you for every enemy it hits; while you are at full life the healing becomes extra damage instead, and each blow sprays blood in an arc that cuts those beside what it hits.
bloodlust.behindText: Enemies it kills drop life orbs; picking one up gives Power's damage bonus and lets out a red shockwave that throws back the enemies near you.
bloodlust.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; hits harder and has more life. At full life it goes into a bloodlust, red mist rising off it, and charges you.

bloodtide.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; heals you for every enemy hit, allies near you too, and the life drawn flows to you as a red tide streaming in from all it hit.
bloodtide.behindText: Each hit splashes onto the enemies near what it hits, and the splash heals you as well; every third hit, the splash rolls out as a red wave that throws back the enemies it reaches.
bloodtide.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; its attacks reach wider, and its healing reaches the monsters near it in red streams, each it heals hitting harder for a few seconds.

blur.frontText: Faster to use again; at a full frenzy of five you also move faster and dodge more, and you blur: afterimages trail you, striking the enemies they pass through.
blur.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going and give you a burst of speed; while it lasts, enemies you pass close by are struck by your blur.
blur.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; moves and attacks faster. Badly hurt, it becomes a blur for a few seconds, flickering round you and striking from every side.

brimstone.frontText: Fire damage that explodes, sets enemies burning and curses them; a cursed enemy burns hotter, and one that dies burning bursts in a gout of sulphur fire that burns and curses those near.
brimstone.behindText: Leaves a burning hex circle; enemies inside deal less damage and are set burning, and a jet of fire spouts from it each second, burning what it catches.
brimstone.monsterText: Deals fire damage and sets you burning; its blows curse you, your burning lasts longer while you are cursed, and while you burn, brimstone falls round you: step from under it.

bullseye.frontText: A much bigger area, a little less damage; the enemy nearest its middle takes a certain critical, and target rings flash on it as it lands, blowing the enemies round it back.
bullseye.behindText: Marks every enemy near what it hits, target rings over each; your certain critical on one bursts its rings, striking those round it.
bullseye.monsterText: Its attacks reach wider. Target rings close in round you as it winds up: stand at their heart when its blow lands and the hit is critical.

burden.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns, and curses; the curse lasts twice as long on a stunned enemy, and a dark weight settles on what it stuns and curses, falling away with a crash that staggers those beside it as the stun ends.
burden.behindText: Leaves cracked ground inside a hex circle; enemies inside deal less damage, those it staggers are cursed, and chains of the curse rise from the cracks to hold what it curses there for a moment.
burden.monsterText: Its blows knock you back and curse you; you are knocked farther while you are cursed, and a dark weight settles on you, slowing you.

cataclysm.frontText: A much bigger area; the hit lands harder for every enemy it catches, and when it catches four or more the ground splits open under them in a burst of rock that throws them all back.
cataclysm.behindText: Each hit splashes harder onto the enemies near what it hits, and the splash cracks the ground, rock bursting up round what it hit and staggering those there.
cataclysm.monsterText: Hits harder and has more life; its attacks reach much wider, and every third blow splits the ground round you, rock bursting up under you.

cauterize.frontText: Killing a burning enemy heals you a chunk, and its fire leaps into you as it dies, a lick of flame that sears your wounds.
cauterize.behindText: Killing a burning enemy heals you a little, and its embers scatter, setting the enemies near it burning.
cauterize.monsterText: Low on life it sears its wounds shut, once, in a flare of fire that burns you if you are close.

coldblood.frontText: Frost damage that chills, then freezes; it heals you twice as much from chilled or frozen enemies, the warmth drawn out of them in red wisps to you.
coldblood.behindText: Leaves ice that slows; enemies that die on the ice drop life orbs more often, and shatter as they fall, chilling those near.
coldblood.monsterText: Heals when it hits you; deals frost damage and slows you, heals twice as much while you are chilled, and while you are chilled it draws your warmth to it in red wisps.

daze.frontText: Slower, hits much harder; its stun is shorter, but every hit on a stunned enemy lands harder, knocking stars from it that fly to the enemies beside it and daze them too.
daze.behindText: Its cracked ground staggers in quick, short jolts, more often, each jolt throwing up dust that dazes what it catches.
daze.monsterText: Its blows knock you back; while you are staggered it hits you harder, and stars wheel round your head, slowing you.

doubletap.frontText: Strikes twice, a smaller area; when the first blow is a critical hit the second is a certain critical too, and a double critical rings out in a crack that staggers the enemies round it.
doubletap.behindText: Marks two enemies at once: your next hit on each is a certain critical, and a thread of light links the two: striking one strikes the other too.
doubletap.monsterText: Attacks twice; its hits find the gaps in your armour, and when its first blow is critical, so is its second; its second blow knocks you down for a moment.

feedingfrenzy.frontText: Each use makes the next faster, up to five times, and the higher the frenzy, the more each hit heals you; at a full frenzy it feeds, red streams pouring from each enemy you hit into you.
feedingfrenzy.behindText: Kills keep the frenzy going, and at a full frenzy enemies it kills give up their life in orbs that fly to you on their own, healing you.
feedingfrenzy.monsterText: Speeds up as it is hurt; heals when it hits you, more the faster it goes, and badly hurt it gorges, swelling red and healing a chunk.

fetters.frontText: Strikes twice, each time weaker; an enemy held by the first strike is held again by the second, half as long again, and the cuff chains it to the nearest other enemy: neither can go far from the other.
fetters.behindText: Leaves a snare, and a moment later a second one beside it; what one catches is chained to the nearest other enemy.
fetters.monsterText: Attacks twice; its blows root you, and each leaves a cuff and chain on your feet that slows you once the root ends.

flechette.frontText: Breaks into three copies that fly twice as fast and strike a third harder, each pinning what it hits to the ground for a moment with a quivering dart.
flechette.behindText: Where it ends, shards fly out twice as fast and twice as far, and darts stick in the ground in a ring round where it ended, cutting what crosses them.
flechette.monsterText: Its poison and burning hurt you faster; splits in two when it dies, its halves quicker, and as it splits it sprays darts at you.

fortress.frontText: Slower, hits much harder and stuns; each use gives you a shield, while it holds nothing knocks you back or stuns you, and your blows behind it land like a falling wall: a slab of stone drops on what you hit, staggering those beside it.
fortress.behindText: Leaves a ward circle; enemies stepping into it are staggered, and a stone tower rises at its heart that hurls a stone at each enemy that steps in.
fortress.monsterText: Carries a shield that soaks damage; its blows knock you back; while its shield holds nothing staggers or stops it, and its blows slam you into a wall of stone it raises behind you, stunning you.

frostbite.frontText: Chilled enemies lose life over time, and frozen ones twice as fast; frost creeps over a chilled one, and as the chill wears off the frost cracks away in a burst that chills those near.
frostbite.behindText: The ice on the ground poisons what crosses it, and black frost creeps out from it toward the nearest enemy.
frostbite.monsterText: While it has chilled you, you bleed cold, and blue frostbite spreads over you: stay chilled long and you freeze for a moment.
